notes.title: 🚜 Update 1.9.2 – Vehicle Switching Overhaul!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello Miners! ⚒️
[/b][/h2][p]We’ve just overhauled the [b]Vehicle Switching System[/b] – and it’s a game-changer for how you dig, drive, and dominate the claim.[/p][p]No more guessing. No more clicking through random machines.
Now [b]you’re in control.[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]What’s new in 1.9.2? 😎[/h3][p][/p][p]➡️ [b]Pick your ride – when you want[/b][/p][p]Forget cycling through every vehicle. Now you choose exactly which machine to hop into – fast and easy.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/0328b4d33cd9f26b0f5962ceb8d72c4b1855b683.gif"][/img][/p][p]📋 [b]Reorder your lineup[/b][/p][p]Got a favorite setup? Put your most-used vehicles at the top of the list and dig with max efficiency.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/d07de487fb5c3b7cbb5d972c8220fa2dc2890810.gif"][/img][/p][p]📏 [b]Know the distance before you move[/b][/p][p]Every machine now shows how far it is from you – plus a handy direction marker so you always know where to head next.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/e138f8125875cbebbc51f9d11647f1aab75cbef3.gif"][/img][/p][p]Do you know where else this feature will be available?[/p][h2]In Gold Mining Simulator 2, obviously![/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2885380/Gold_Mining_Simulator_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Fuel up and test it out – and as always, let us know what you think!
See you in the dirt 👷‍♂️💰[/p][p][/p][h2][i]📲 Follow us for more updates:[/i][/h2][p][b]TikTok[/b]: [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@code_horizon_games"]https://www.tiktok.com/@code_horizon_games[/url][/p][p][b]Facebook[/b]: [url="https://www.facebook.com/goldminingsimulator/"]https://www.facebook.com/goldminingsimulator/[/url][/p][p][b]X (ex-Twitter)[/b]: [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Ftwitter.com%2FGoldRushTheGame"]@GoldRushTheGame[/url][/p][p][b]Join our Discord[/b]: [url="https://discord.gg/goldminingsimulator"]https://discord.gg/goldminingsimulator[/url][/p][p][b]YouTube[/b]:  [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@CodeHorizon"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h3]Check our other games 👇 [/h3][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/GoldMining/"]https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/GoldMining/[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Season 39 kicks off today in Gold Mining Simulator! 🔥
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello, Miners! ⚒️[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Things are about to get exciting! Because [b]Today at 9AM Pacific Time (PT)[/b], [b]Season 39 starts in Gold Mining Simulator! It's time to gear up and have some fun![/b] ⌚[/p][p][/p][h3]🔥 What’s new for this season?🔥[/h3][p]
So, what awaits? Let's see! 😎

We have been working on the [b]transport container[/b], to improve the transporting quality. [b]Now you can load it up with items like cables, buckets, and more — then move the whole thing to another claim using the transport menu.[/b] Simple as that! 💪

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/d713a55e44aabdd6c6096b1dc215134da55c3413.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Another thing that has been improved is the [b]process of transporting machines[/b]. Now [b]you can transport all the items in container in the transport window with just one click.[/b] 🖱️[/p][p]Remember that there was an issue with texture resolution — when digging or dumping dirt, weird square patches would show up on the ground? Now [b]it's fixed[/b]! No more squares after digging 😎
it works after the reset of the parcel and on the new saves.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/f4ea37e1b8c9559a0e111ae60e512550e083ce09.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We have also fixed the FPS matter. Now the game should run smoother and more efficent. [/p][p]We took a closer look at the restore function and gave it an upgrade — [b]it now properly puts the Cordylus and Mini Excavator back together if they get glitched.[/b][/p][h3]

[b]A good news for aesthetic fans. New pair of skins arrives![/b][/h3][p][b]Remember Miners! In this season rewards are for top 50 for DLC and top 10 for non DLC! [/b][/p][p]Collect all 22 crates and you’ll unlock the [b]Quad Hot Rod[/b]. And if you rank top 50 on the leaderboard at the end of the season, you’ll earn the [b]Neon skin[/b] for the Small Excavator![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/5b14380f68a939c7cb8019112ea70576fc198a1d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/196f97b3b105f34f3b3f213719d41a32ffa3511c.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b] This seasonal parcel is Nighthawk![/b][/h3][p][/p][h3] [b]Changelog [1.9.0]:[/b][/h3][p]➕[Added] Transport container,[/p][p]➕[Added] Transport all machines with one click,[/p][p]🛠️[Fixed] Stable improved FPS,[/p][p]🛠️[Fixed] Squares of dirt on parcel after dropping dirt (on new saves and after reset),[/p][p]🛠️[Fixed] Player camera shaking on uneven ground,[/p][p]🛠️[Fixed] Mats and grills won't be charged when in rented machines,[/p][p]🛠️[Fixed] Player won't be peeking out of the vehicles anymore,[/p][p]🔄[Changed] Transport machines by clicking on them in transport window,[/p][p]🔄[Changed] Restore function on Cordylus and mini Excavator will now put machine together if glitched.
[/p][p] [/p][h2][i]📲 Follow us for more updates:[/i][/h2][p][b]TikTok[/b]: [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@code_horizon_games"]https://www.tiktok.com/@code_horizon_games[/url][/p][p][b]Facebook[/b]: [url="https://www.facebook.com/goldminingsimulator/"]https://www.facebook.com/goldminingsimulator/[/url][/p][p][b]X (ex-Twitter)[/b]: [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Ftwitter.com%2FGoldRushTheGame"]@GoldRushTheGame[/url][/p][p][b]Join our Discord[/b]: [url="https://discord.gg/goldminingsimulator"]https://discord.gg/goldminingsimulator[/url][/p][p][b]YouTube[/b]: [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@CodeHorizon"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]

As we promised yesterday - here we come with the [b]newest, end of the season update[/b] for Gold Mining Simulator!

🔧[Fixed] Light system trailer now has improved textures, making text on it readable.

🔧[Fixed] Planter’s bucket will no longer detach on its own.
🔧[Fixed] S-T Sluicebox worker now clears all Sluicebox Grates properly.
🔧[Fixed] Translation error on machines switch button prompt corrected.

🔧[Fixed] Closing the tablet no longer disrupts gamepad controls.
🔧[Fixed] Quad power and steering improved.

🔧[Fixed] Cordylus no longer folds the wrong way after loading a game when purchased in the town and stored in the machine storage.

notes.title: Welcome to Gold Mining Simulator 2`s steampage! 👋
notes.content:
Hello, Miners! 👋

With great pleasure we want to welcome you on [b]Gold Mining Simulator 2[/b]’s steam page! Whether you're a seasoned prospector or just starting your journey, get ready to dig deep, refine your techniques, and strike it rich, as Gold Mining Simulator is coming to a different level - [b]this time, with your friends in a multiplayer mode[/b]! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2885380/Gold_Mining_Simulator_2/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/4bc83c527494628b284cba19485869e185becdc6.png[/img]

[h3]What's coming with Gold Mining Simulator 2? 📢 [/h3] 
We aim to create GMS 2 [b]with passion and respect[/b] to all of our fans - what's the most important, the game will be [b]based on the analyzed feedback of our playerbase[/b]. With the strong base of the already existing Gold Mining Simulator, we want to meet your expectations and add our own ideas. 

[h3]What has happened so far? 📅 [/h3]
Since the new team joined the company at the end of 2023 and took over the project, we have [b]switched the engine from UE4 to UE5[/b]. 💥 This took a considerable amount of time, but it was necessary, as we want to [b]support the game for a long time and expand it with future expansions[/b]! 🎁 We've also added a new map, NPCs, sidequests, changed approach to Gold support and communication. 🏆

[h3]Communication 💬 [/h3]
[b]Communication with our player is the most important factor for us[/b]. We want to communicate [b]directly and frequently[/b], which is why we’ve hired a new Community Manager specifically for the players. There will be plenty of [b]devlogs[/b] about the game's development as well! If you want to be a part of the game's development, give us feedback and ideas and talk to the devs directly - [url=https://discord.gg/goldminingsimulator]join our Discord[/url].
📢 The German player base has a significant percentage share in GMS 1. We appreciate it, and from now on, all news will also be available in German! 📢

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KzFk8BzDCPY][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/5207273f881e65d6e349c8b3810b6b720b91b083.png[/img][/url]

[b]🎬 Join our live Q&A stream on YouTube[/b] (03.02 at 17:00 CET) to discuss the Steam page, trailer, and your questions! You cannot miss this! 

Don’t forget to add the game to your [b]Steam wishlist[/b] - it will let us know that you’re really hyped about it, and above all, will let you be up to date with everything related to GMS2! 

You can sign up for the playtests now on Steam - please note, that they are not starting right away. After signing up you will be notified once they start, so stay tuned for the annoucenements. There may be more playtests in the future - let’s see how it goes!

notes.title: ⛏️ Development for 2025: Our Roadmap! 🗺️
notes.content:
Hello, miners! 👋

Thanks to your feedback and support, Gold Mining Simulator gets better and better with every update. We know how much you value transparency, so we want to share with you [b]our plans for the upcoming year[/b]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/04cd0557e2f69fdf9d9c3f957b342a9b7d80d30f.jpg[/img]

We’ve prepared a list of changes and new features we plan to introduce in 2025. 📋 It’s the result of many discussions, analyses, and feedback we’ve received from you. Please note that the upcoming features are not listed in any order. We will do our best to deliver them as planned, as we don’t want to disappoint you. 💪

[h2]Gold Mining Simulator Roadmap 2025[/h2]

[list]
[*] [New] Official support for joysticks
[*] [New] Indicator showing rented machines 
[*] [New] New machine - Fuel truck
[*] [Fix] Bulldozer terrain cutting efficiency
[*] [New] New machine - Big bulldozer
[*] [New] New machine -  Backhoe loader
[*] [New] Ability to setup the Orange Beast on every parcel 
[*] [Fix] Quad improvements – more power, selling option, trailer hitch
[*] [Fix] Cordylus improvements – faster rotation and added hopper
[*] [New] Ability to use Cordylus with dumptruck
[*] [Fix] Comprehensive planter bug fixes
[*] [Fix] Camera clipping through ground while digging 
[*] [Fix] Steam Achievements overhaul – verifying and ensuring proper functionality 
[*] [Fix] Waterfall Valley bedrock bug 
[*] [New] Vehicles switching system overhaul
[*] [New] Saving highlighted areas between sessions
[*] [New] New item - Dynamite
[*] [New] Ability to carry multiple mats and mosses at once 
[*] [New] New item - Transport container integrated with the in-game transport system
[*] [New] Drill indicator
[*] [Fix] Tree shader improvements
[*] [Fix] Increased visibility of water in bucket
[*] [New] Shovel skins
[*] [Update] Shader system overhaul – smaller files for quicker updates and faster loading
[*] [Update] Game engine update – improved performance and easier content updates
[*] [Update] Improved driving system for better machine control
[/list]

[h3]GOLD MINING SIMULATOR 2 is coming![/h3]
With great pleasure we want to welcome you on [b]Gold Mining Simulator 2[/b]’s steam page! Whether you're a seasoned prospector or just starting your journey, get ready to dig deep, refine your techniques, and strike it rich, as Gold Mining Simulator is coming to a different level - [b]this time, with your friends in a multiplayer mode[/b]! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2885380/Gold_Mining_Simulator_2/

An independent team is working on GMS 2, on top of the one that already supports GMS1 in smaller numbers.

To make your search more exciting and rewarding, we’ve added jingling bells to each gift, so you can hear them before you spot them. If you manage to find all 22 hidden gifts, you’ll unlock a special series of festive Christmas skins as your reward. 

[i]The hunt is on—good luck and happy searching![/i]

notes.title: Great update and big changes
notes.content:
Dear Gold Seekers,

We are thrilled to announce that significant changes are coming to the world of Gold Rush: The Game, changes that will transform the way you experience treasure hunting in the wilds of Alaska. 
From [b]April 1, 2024[/b], we are stepping into an entirely new chapter that will redefine your adventure in the quest for gold.

First and foremost, we would like to unveil that our beloved game will adopt a completely new name, one that captures the spirit and character of what it means to be a true gold prospector. Alongside the new name, we are introducing a fresh visual overhaul that will breathe new life into the game world and make every detail even more captivating.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/7c5e3f665450ea7dd90ff946f8218162b8cfd1a8.png[/img]

But that's not all. This massive update is not just about rebranding and visual refreshment. It also entails a deep revamp of the gameplay itself. We are fixing bu[b]g[/b]s, introducing new features, and delivering content that will rejuvenate your adventures. [b]NEW DLC is comming![/b]

However, the most exciting part of this update is that it will be rolled out across [b]all platforms[/b] simultaneously! Yes, you heard it right - whether you're playing on PC or console, you will be able to enjoy the same incredible gaming experience. [b]The console update[/b] will be on par with the PC version, ensuring all players can explore the sa[b]m[/b]e terrains and tackle the same challenges.

But that's just the tip of the iceberg. With this update on [b]Playstation[/b] and [b]Xbox[/b], we are also introducing the long-awaited seasons and rewards. Now your experience with Gold Rush: The Game will be even more dynamic, with varying weather conditions and challenge[b]s[/b] that change throughout the year.

We know you've been eagerly anticipating this update, so we are pleased to announce that we expect to roll it out in the first half of the second quarter of [b]2[/b]024. Get ready for new challenges, new discoveries, and new adventures!

Thank you for your support and dedication in the pursuit of gold. Together, we will make history!

Sincerely,
The Gold Rush: The Game Team

notes.title: Hotfix 1.7.0
notes.content:
[b]Dear Miners,[/b]
Today we will be releasing a hotfix that address an invisible quad in the part shop issue and as well update to the steam cloud saving. Now steam cloud shouldn't turn OFF automatically after exiting a game. We've made a small tutorial on how to properly enable steam cloud and how to do backup for your game files.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/1e89b51785c419c839b28a6d53f63d0bcdae8d87.png[/img]

[h3][b]Please before turning ON steam cloud saves make sure to backup your save files!![/b][/h3]

[b]How to create a backup for your save files:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Open file explorer and go to: %localappdata%low\CodeHorizon\GoldRushTheGame\Saves
[*] Copy the entire folder called "Saves" to your desktop - [b]DO NOT CUT IT, JUST COPY![/b]
[*] That's it, now follow the other steps to enable Steam Cloud saves
[/olist]
[b]How to enable Steam Cloud Saving:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Go to your Steam library
[*] Right click on a Gold Rush: The Game then click properties
[*] In the General tab you need to check the steam cloud option
[*] You can now exit the tab
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/c3b490815b5c65cfcfc7028f9e101cc20ee38eb4.png[/img]

Now it should automatically put your save files that you have on your local storage to the steam cloud, and it will update it every time you will exit your game. If it's says that the steam cloud is not synchronised just click on it and click retry synchronising, now it should upload properly.

If you encounter any issues please contact us on Discord server and we will try to help you. Thank you!

[h1]Season 29 Patch[/h1]
[list]
[b][u]Core[/u] features:[/b][list]
[*] [b][i][added][/i][/b] The gold distribution [u]is now randomized[/u] on [i]every[/i] claim [i](the overview below is just an example; you might have a different distribution in your game).[/i]
[*] [b][i][added][/i][/b] Additionally, [u]each claim features a unique distribution[/u] with its own pros and cons [i](e.g., Old Arnold's has an even distribution while having less overall gold than Nighthawk, but Nighthawk requires lots of drilling to find rich deposits).[/i]
[*] [b][i][balanced][/i][/b] [u]Increased drilling range[/u] for manual drilling[i] (mostly likely you'll make 9 holes, sometimes 6, and rarely 4 - instead of the usual 1 to 4 per use).[/i][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/ffaf5ad19b49c0bdf71ddbdb069c86cb1d2106be.png[/img]
[b]Gold distribution [u]per claim[/u]:[/b][list]
[*] [b][i][Old Arnold's][/i][/b] - [i]even[/i] distribution, [i]low[/i] density.
[*] [b][i][River Town][/i][/b] - very [i]big clumps[/i] of [i]moderate[/i] density.
[*] [b][i][Pine Valley][/i][/b] - a lot of [i]small clumps[/i] of [i]high[/i] density.
[*] [b][i][Nighthawk][/i][/b] - a few [i]very small clumps[/i] of [i]very high density.[/i][/list]
[b][u]Seasonal[/u] features:[/b][list]
[*] [b][i][adjusted chest locations][/i][/b] [i]Quest for chests:[/i] Grab [i][b]up to 22 chests[/b][/i] placed randomly around Heines, Alaska. As a reward, you will receive a [u]buff per chest[/u] that applies in the current season.
[*] [b][i][balanced][/i][/b] The value of [i]extra gold nuggets[/i] from drilling [i]has been slightly increased[/i] after the previous reduction.
[*] [b][i][added][/i][/b] The [i]Pine Valley[/i] parcel rent price was set to [i]$0[/i].
[*] [b][i][removed][/i][/b] The [i]Nighthawk[/i] parcel rent price has [i]returned to its default value.[/i]
[*] [b][i][added][/i][/b] Fade into the night with the new [i]Season #29[/i] [u]anthracite excavator skin[/u] ([b]winners only![/b]).[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/c57fdda6e117b96b69a2ed927f4013423cba1886.png[/img]
[/list]
[b]Thank you[/b] for sending us all the reports and suggestions.
You're awesome human beings!

notes.title: Patch 1.6.2.15428
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/739a2db1c682efa316d80f072dcc8fab75323a75.png[/img]
[h1]Season 28 Patch[/h1]
[list]
[b]Season 28 features:[/b][list]
[*] [b][i][vanilla mode][/i][/b] We continue [i]experimenting with a vanilla experience[/i], so the current season will be [i]even more challenging[/i]! On the upside, we have [u]restored our chest buffs[/u] ;-)
[*] [b][i][adjusted chest locations][/i][/b] [i]Quest for chests:[/i] Find [i][b]up to 22 chests[/b][/i] placed around Heines, Alaska. By doing so, you will be granted a [u]buff per chest[/u] for your seasonal journey.
[*] [b][i][balanced][/i][/b] The amount and value of [i]extra gold nuggets[/i] from drilling or digging[i] have been reduced[/i] [i](you'll get the [b]same amount[/b] of gold and magnetite [b]from other activities[/b])[/i].
[*] [b][i][added][/i][/b] [i]Nighthawk[/i] parcel rent price is set to [i]$0[/i].
[*] [b][i][removed][/i][/b] [i]Old Arnold’s[/i] parcel rent price has [i]returned to its default value.[/i]
[*] [b][i][added][/i][/b] [u]Thunder strikes twice[/u] with the new [i]Season #28[/i] [u]excavator skin[/u] ([b]go for it![/b]).[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/45b71c1ca07d3ecb3b18320136d281218ba20b5f.png[/img]
[b]Additional changes and updates:[/b][list]
[*] [b][i][fixed][/i][/b] Your character won't be stuck or leave the playable area when exiting vehicles (hopefully!).
[*] [b][i][fixed][/i][/b] No more flying through a gas station's roof due to improved collision handling.
[*] [b][i][fixed][/i][/b] Money is no longer needed to claim a special Halloween skin (only when the event is active, obviously!).
[*] [b][i][fixed][/i][/b] Notifications will display properly when re-enabling the GUI.
[*] [b][i][adjusted][/i][/b] Stopped you from running through the Bulldozer or Frankenstein thanks to our chunky colliders.
[*] [b][i][adjusted][/i][/b] Some machines received missing sound effects.
[*] [b][i][adjusted][/i][/b] Ended Nighthawk's space program by smoothing out collision data (boo-hoo!).
[*] [b][i][fixed][/i][/b] No more sliding UI buttons (on the in-game tablet).
[*] [b][i][balance][/i][/b] Removed various in-game discount-related exploits.
[*] [b][i][fixed][/i][/b] Skipping a day's summary should work properly while playing on the gamepad.
[*] [b][i][fixed][/i][/b] Fill-level indicators in duplex jig should fill as intended.
[*] [b][i][fixed][/i][/b] Corrected minor translation and formatting issues.
[*] [b][i][fixed][/i][/b] We've also sent our brave construction workers to fix garage gates, potholes, and other minor visual glitches.
[/list][/list]
[b]Thank you[/b] for sending us all the reports and suggestions.
You're awesome human beings! 

Feel free to [b]join us[/b] on our Discord server:
https://discordapp.com/invite/goldrush-thegame

https://store.steampowered.com/app/451340/Gold_Rush_The_Game/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/d3670546f7b513dc231a12e2d27e96023fe5a255.png[/img]
[h1]Season 27 Patch[/h1]
[list]
[b]Season 27 features:[/b][list]
[*] [b][i][vanilla mode][/i][/b] The current season is [u]a tribute to the original Gold Rush experience[/u]; all seasonal bonuses [i](a.k.a. "buffs")[/i] have been [i]temporarily suspended[/i].
[*] [b][i][added][/i][/b] Old Arnold's parcel rent price is set to [i]$0[/i].
[*] [b][i][removed][/i][/b] River Town's rent price returned to its default value.
[*] [b][i][fixed][/i][/b] Skins for [i]Seasons #23[/i] - [i]#26[/i] are now accessible ([u]apologies, Winners![/u]).
[*] [b][i][added][/i][/b] A new [i]bee-utiful[/i] skin for [i]Season #27[/i] Winners has been added ([b]good luck![/b]).
[/list]
[b]Additional changes and updates:[/b][list]
[*] [b][i][adjusted][/i][/b] Addressed the gold nugget issue in Leaderboard mode to level the playing field for everyone.
[*] [b][i][adjusted][/i][/b] Changed the minimal sensitivity level for the mouse to enable fine tuning (from 15% to 5%).
[*] [b][i][adjusted][/i][/b] Slightly adjusted lightning levels to address issues with high overcast at night.
[*] [b][i][added][/i][/b] Reworked some of the road signs to match those in Alaska's regions.
[*] [b][i][fixed][/i][/b] Updated progression logic for achievements "Gold on the Ceiling II" and "III".
[*] [b][i][fixed][/i][/b] Improved input handling for the ESC button in Machine Store.
[*] [b][i][fixed][/i][/b] Smoothed out collision data near the Old Alaskan Bridge (close to the rails).
[*] [b][i][fixed][/i][/b] Reworked visual representation of gold panning (more stages visible).
[*] [b][i][fixed][/i][/b] Transport Crate, Water Splitter, and Glacier Creek area received various LOD tweaks.
[*] [b][i][fixed][/i][/b] Reworked applying snow details to the excavator and other minor visual glitches.
[/list][/list]
[b]Thank you[/b] for sending us all the reports and suggestions.
You're awesome human beings!

notes.title: Patch 1.5.5.15041
notes.content:
[h1]Season 21 Update features[/h1]
[list]

New Season 21 Leaderboards features:

[list]
[*] Treasure Hunt: We’ve placed 22 gold bars for you to find on Nighthawk Parcel and other points of interest in the city! Each one will give you a buff to attributes, such as how much gold you mine, how little fuel your machinery consumes, or how fast you move.
[*] Nighthawk rent price is set to 0$
[/list]

Previous season features present in Season 21 Leaderboards:

[list]
[*] Every worker's level is set to maximum.
[*] Blacksmith upgrades are maxed out (Blacksmith must be first visited for the upgrades to apply).
[*] Nuggets from drilling are capped at 1400 oz.
[/list]

Previous season features [b]not present[/b] in Season 21 Leaderboards:

[list]
[*] Tracked vehicles now move 50% faster.
[*] 40% more gold in summer.
[*] 40% more gold during the day. (from 6 a.m. till 6 p.m.)
[*] Water is now 25% more expensive.
[*] Fuel is now 30% more expensive.
[*] River Town rent price is set to 0$
[/list]

Bug Fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Mobile Washplant Engine mesh would still be visible even after removing it from the machine.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented selecting “Visible weather effects” in Graphics settings when using the controller.
[*] Fixed an issue that made the “Falling Snow” option change its status when selecting apply in Visible weather effects options.
[*] Fixed High Voltage Power Cable highlight.
[*] Fixed High Voltage Power Extension Cord position when connected.
[*] Fixed a bug where the game would autosave after each season even after completely disabling the autosave option.
[*] Fixed Bulldozer’s collision.
[*] Fixed Trailer Wheel’s collision.
[*] Added List of Spare parts for Mobile Water Tank in the journal.
[*] Added Specification for Conveyor Belt’s Hopper in the journal.
[*] Fixed parts of Spanish, Italian, and French translations where the texts would overlap.
[*] Fixed an issue where Big Electric/Diesel Water Pump text would overlap with the image in the journal.
[*] Fixed a bug that made Cordless Screwdriver hang in the air after selecting another tool.
[*] Fixed a bug where dirt gathered on a small shovel would also appear on other save files.
[*] Fixed a bug that was causing DIGtube to play wrong videos when picking up an item during Tutorial Stage II.
[*] Fixed an issue where pressing V would select Cordless Screwdriver. (Controls must be reset to default for the fix to apply)
[*] Other minor bug fixes.
[/list]
[/list]

[b]Thank you[/b] for sending us all the reports and suggestions. 
You're awesome human beings! 
If you are not on our discord server yet, please join us:
https://discordapp.com/invite/goldrush-thegame

https://store.steampowered.com/app/451340/Gold_Rush_The_Game/

notes.content:
[list]
FEATURES:
[*]Leaderboards Season 10 started (for this season only: changed starting map - Pine Valley costs now 0$ when rented, drill cover is bigger now, gold nuggets will spawn for using the drill)
[*]Rewards for Season 9

[*]GamePad - In sleep mechanic it was possible to add sleeping hours to 1000,  now it is limited from 1 to 24 hours
[*]Around 50 various UI fixes for Tablet, Map, Journal, Blacksmith, Notifications, Main menu, Fuel station

[*]Big Excavator - After transport to Storage, save, reload and transport to the plot, it is impossible to lower the BE arm
[*]Stage 1 Tutorial - Players without Gold Nugget go to Blacksmith with 1.9g of gold, which they cannot melt - now the quest disappears only when you enter the panning system after the first cleaning

[*]Conveyor Belt Hopper - Although the Wash Plant Engine Fan Belt is broken, the soil is delivered to Conveyor Belta anyway
[*]Trommel - Moves faster than the chain speed (Trommel Chain)
[*]Stage 3 Tutorial - Front-End Loader - Attaching to it completes the task of attaching things to the Excavator
[*]Blacksmith - Buying upgrades with Magnetite will crash the game
[*]FastTravel price 20k

[*]Bars over 99 oz have no decimal zero
[*]Big Diesel Water Pump, Mobile Water Tank, Big Electric Water Pump, Big Diesel Water Pump - The part for attaching to the Pickup is turned 180 degrees

[/list]

notes.title: Time to start Season 9!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Miners![/h1]

Welcome to [b]Leaderboards Season 9[/b]!

This time you will compete in a 35-day season, making 13th August the end date. The top 10 miners in each Leaderboard will be awarded a shiny, shiny [b][i]Trommel skin[/i][/b] (see below).


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/09ef288157696c858c8084b6efa56c4875f05aec.png[/img]

[h1]Known bugs[/h1]

We are aware of the News section not displaying in the Menu. We are working on fixing the issue ASAP. All the necessary information is included in this post.

[h1]Feedback[/h1]
If you've stumbled upon a bug in Gold Rush, please report it by sending us an e-mail:
bugs@goldrush-thegame.com
or by starting a new thread on Steam discussions:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/451340/discussions/2/


Finally, we'd love to hear what you think about our game. If you haven't yet, please drop us a review on the Gold Rush Steam page.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/451340/Gold_Rush_The_Game/

[b]Now let's get digging![/b]

notes.title: The Steam Workshop Update + Summer Sale!
notes.content:
[h3]Howdy, Miners![/h3]
We're kicking off this Summer Sale with a brand new addition to the game. From now you can use [b]the Steam Workshop[/b] for all of your skin-changing business. But what does it mean, exactly?

[previewyoutube=X_vGToGT2bA;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Freedom of skins![/h2]
[list]
[*] Countless free skins made by our lovely community
[*] Comfortable skin browsing and installation
[*] A chance for your own creations to be downloaded by players all around the world!
[/list]
You can access all of that by going to the game's community 'Workshop' tab.

[h2]Free Pickup Skin[/h2]
Especially for this occasion Woody, our team's top mechanic, prepared a free Day 1 skin, ready to be applied onto your rusty pickup trucks:

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2132954326
[h2]Custom Skins Guide[/h2]
If you fancy yourself a talented creator, be sure to grab the custom skin guide which you can find linked in our changelog:
https://steamcommunity.com/games/451340/announcements/detail/2502261702436831577

[h2]Steam Summer Sale[/h2]
If your friends are still staying at home, missing all the fun that comes from digging in the dirt... let them know that we're [u][b]50% off![/b][/u]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/451340/Gold_Rush_The_Game/

And as always...
Let's get digging! ⛏️

A new patch has arrived, bringing you the fixes you've been waiting for. In addition, you can now 𝒄𝒖𝒔𝒕𝒐𝒎𝒊𝒛𝒆 𝒚𝒐𝒖𝒓 𝒘𝒂𝒔𝒉𝒑𝒍𝒂𝒏𝒕 however you like.

Not sure how to add your own skins to the game? Check out this handy guide:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1P4f94ft2IL2kCj6n0GKaCXmXhEbhBzUpG2h-gROe-FY
[h2]Changelog[/h2]
See the full patch notes here:
https://steamcommunity.com/games/451340/partnerevents/view/1798565384426164754
[h2]A big thank you[/h2]
to all of you who reported issues and provided suggestions. Keep it up!

And let's get modding! ⛏

notes.title: Leaderboards Season 7 is here!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Miners![/h1]
We have released patch number 1.5.5.13877 which starts the [u]Leaderboards Season 7[/u].

If you haven't had a chance to participate in the leaderboards yet, this is a great time to do so. This season you'll be digging your way to the top up until [b]April 2[/b].

The best base game players will be rewarded with a special skin for the [b][i]Small Excavator[/i][/b]. Those who compete in the DLC category will also receive a new look for their [i][b]Frankenstein[/b][/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/f745c155b79acc7d94d11f77b1e078cbcdd30e78.png[/img]

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
You can find the full list of changes in version 1.5.5.13877 here:

notes.title: Consoles update
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Miners![/h1]

As promised - more info about X1 and PS4 ports below - there’s also something for PC fans!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=505Ztf6bMgw

What to expect from [b]X1[/b] and [b]PS4[/b] versions?
[list]
[*][b]1:1[/b] port of gold mining experience from PC,
[*]entire gameplay content released so far,
[*][b]2 years of updates[/b] and fixes already in.
[/list]
As you might know the end of the year in game dev industry is pretty intense. Our studio is making sure that the upcoming release is thoroughly checked for any possible issues. Quality improvements should be also experienced in PC version. 

What delays us the most is continuous synchronization between living PC game and the upcoming ports. We know that we tentatively announced ports for [u]Q4 2019[/u], but there are [b]2 essential steps[/b] ahead of us:
[list]
[*]Certification testing (mandatory for publishing the game on consoles)
[*]Setting release date with all partners (not only publishers – it’s a licensed product after all)
[/list]

Those are the main reasons why we have to delay the release ([b]unofficially to Q1 2020[/b]) – and for that we are truly sorry. We are totally aware that you are waiting for console version for such a long time – we can promise that you’ll be the first to know if there’s ANY new info.

Be sure that we will continue to support PC version and leaderboard system. You keep sending us so many amazing ideas, it would be shame not to use them to create more content!

And again - thank you for your continuous support – [i][u]there’s no Gold Rush without you[/u][/i]!

P.S. There’s [b]Xmas gift[/b] for everyone with PC version - [u][b]we planned Free DLC event with one of our existing DLCs[/b][/u] – please stay tuned for more info.

notes.title: Leaderboards Season 4 starts now!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/07927933c54323fb464ee2f4c8ca4258eb2e123c.png[/img]

[h1]Hello Miners![/h1]
We have just released a new patch 1.5.5.12849, which marks the beginning of Leaderboards Season 4. A shiny, special Front-End Loader skin awaits for the grittiest prospectors!

We have also implemented multiple bug fixes and improvements. Please check out the full list of changes below!

[h1]Changelog:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Launched Leaderboards Season 4.
[*] Added Machine selection feature to Transport services. From now on, the machine that you want to transport can be selected on the Map.
[*] Added possibility to select and highlight multiple spots on the Gold Map.
[*] Fixed a random event issue whereby the laptop would break for continuous days.
[*] Fixed item rotation on the gamepad.
[*] Added missing fuel consumption parameters to the store.
[*] Rebalanced random events.
[*] Updated Map's legend with new icons.
[*] The open/closed gate Map icon now indicates whether the claim has been purchased or not.
[*] Changed Hog Pan Mats textures on sluiceboxes and in the Gold Nuggetator. They now have different textures depending on their fill level.
[*] Bear attacks can no longer occur when random events are disabled.
[*] The snow-storm can no longer happen on the first two days of the New Game.
[*] Tweaked the responsiveness of the mouse digging mode.
[*] Values are now recalculated in the store depending on the chosen measurement system.
[*] Hog Pan's efficiency now decreases when there's too much gold in it (to avoid stuffing buckets with gold and washing it on the Hog Pan).
[*] Added reinforced durability to other parameters in the Journal.
[*] Adjusted collisions.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby Mobile Water Tank couldn't be used as a water source when the Pressure System was disabled.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby water and power consumption values would appear in the Store even though the Pressure System was disabled.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby paydirt could be duplicated with a Worker assigned to the Hog Pan Sluicebox.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby the bucket that was filled with water could spawn some amounts of paydirt after filling the large bucket.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby Sluicebox Extension's indicator would not hide after detaching it from the Hog Pan No Pump.
[*] Fixed shopping cart gamepad issues.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby it was not possible to fill the Mobile Generator's and Small Diesel Water Pump's fuel tanks up to 100%.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby tent's sheet wouldn't fall after fast-traveling.
[*] Added missing Hog Pan No Pump Prompt about Mats being filled to 100%.
[*] Fixed Transport menu's slide bar issue.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby laptop was not fully visible on 4:3 resolution.
[*] Changed Miner's Moss material in the Warehouse.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby two prompts would appear after one part breaks.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby some Trailers' wheels would spin in the opposite direction.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby Water Tank's valve sound could still be heard when the Master sound volume was set to 0.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby rented Front-End Loader could be sold for the new one's price after loading the game.
[*] Adjusted gamepad's sensitivity in the Equipment Store menu on the laptop.
[*]Updated translations.
[/list]

[h1]Thank you![/h1]
We'd like to thank all players who send us reports and suggestions. Thanks to you, this changelog is so rich. Another round for applause for community translators, who keep the game localized in your languages. You're awesome!

[h1]Feedback[/h1]
If you stumbled upon a bug in Gold Rush, please report it to us, by sending an e-mail to bugs@goldrush-thagame.com or by starting a new thread on Steam discussions:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/451340/discussions/2/

Also, your reviews are extremely important to us. If you haven't done it yet, we'd be grateful if you could drop us a review on Gold Rush Steam page.

Now let's get digging!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/451340/Gold_Rush_The_Game/

notes.title: Update 1.5.5 is LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33009884/24a60ce429250c3c9c8e4ca8f9587207d1a3e7c1.png[/img]
[h1][b]Hello Miners![/b][/h1]
Update 1.5.5 is LIVE and it brings:
[list]
[*] Updated DigTube
[*] Plenty bug and crash fixes
[/list]
With the updated video and brand new text versions of DigTube, you will be able to take the full advantage of your gold mining operation. Multiple fixes should make the experience more enjoyable.

[h1]Changelog:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Updated DigTube.
- Added new categories.
- Updated the layout.
- Added option to display the video version or the text version.
[*] Increased friction on Wash Plants' ladders to reduce the character's sliding.
[*] Added Fuel Consumption parameter to the Store.
[*] Exiting the vehicle should no longer be possible if the character would interfere with collisions or get outside the terrain.
[*] Slightly lowered the ground level under Duplex Jigs' on Nighthawk Valley claim to make it easier to remove buckets.
[*] Reworked Pickup Truck's collision system.
[*] Modified collisions of multiple elements in the game.
[*] Removed several bushes with hitboxes, which are no longer needed after the collisions' rework.
[*] Miner's moss' washing out sound should now be working.
[*] Added missing indicators in Tutorial's Stage 3 and fixed the incorrect ones.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby some LODs wouldn't display lights when observing them from the distance.
[*] Corrected vehicles' lights on various LODs.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby Pickup Truck's engine would sound differently after loading the game, which was saved while the Pickup Truck was working.
[*] Fixed Excavator's working lights texture.
[*] Fixed machines reverse lights' flashing.
[*] Corrected digging sounds.
[*] Corrected Wash Plant Springs' reinforced texture in the Warehouse.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby new Miner's Moss would be filled in 100%.
[*] Added quest task to Tutorial's Stage 3, which requires players to connect the water hose to the Big Water Pump.
[*] Other minor Tutorial fixes.
[*] Corrected factory chimney's smoke emitter on Old Arnold's claim.
[*] Fixed Store's list scrolling on the gamepad.
[*] Cash register's list is now scaled down in the Warehouse if the list is longer then the visible area.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby gamepad would not work after exiting the Machines Store.
[*] Fixed the renting UI dot issue in Machine's Store.
[*] Corrected rusted van's (located near the Bank) hitboxes.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby the water would flow in items placed in Pickup Truck's bed after loading the save.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby the small shovel would appear in the bucket placed in Pickup Truck's bed after loading the save.
[*] Blocked machines' rotation when using Fast Travel.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby Miners Mosses were displayed as broken.
[*] Improved readability of the Internet Radio popup.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby the player could select Fast Travel waypoints on the map on the gamepad even if they were not purchased.
[*] Modified the description of Easy Washplant Placing and Random Events while choosing the difficulty level.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby the rented machine's price would differ every day instead of being fixed for the whole renting period.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby the Pickup Truck would turn invisible after losing the hood and driving to Old Arnold's claim.
[*] Added animation to Start All and Stop All buttons in the Generator.
[*] Added possibility to exit laptop tabs on the keyboard by pressing [Esc].
[*] Fixed Easy Wash Plant Placing issues with certain parts that would not snap correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby Fuel Tank's brake wouldn't work on hills.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby Transport Crate's physics would behave incorrectly when driving over them with Pickup Truck.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby quick-loading the game while panning could cause the game to freeze.
[*] Added Excavator's Leaderboard skin to Top 10 Leaderboards Season 3 players' account.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby Worker's Hire and Upgrade buttons could be selected despite having no Workers.
[*] The prompt informing about the Wash Plant's Mats or Buckets being full is no longer displayed if there are Workers assigned to them.
[*] When opening the map it will now always center on the Pickup Truck if the player is inside it.
[*] Corrected machines' light textures.
[*] Corrected Excavators' and Frankenstein's collisions with claims borders.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby Total Cost on the laptop would reflect the machines' price.
[*] The snow texture is no longer displayed on several items, including Small Trailer's Wheel, Water Splitter, Matt Holder, etc.
[*] Added shadows to School building.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby Main Menu's upper tabs would not be highlighted.
[*] The Head Lamp is no longer turned off after entering and exiting the vehicle.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby active selection in Lease and Buy tabs would skip an element on the gamepad.
[*] All driveable machines now have a direction arrow on the Map.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby the broken Water Tower would have status icons displayed.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby the drill could break despite having Machine Failures option disabled.
[*] Added the option to sort elements in the Laptop Stores.
[*] Reorganization of certain items' location in Store tabs.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby changing the active Worker on the machine would cause the game to freeze.
[*] The controls for switching tools on the gamepad should now be working correctly.
[*] Added option to sort machines in the Machine Store.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby a quest marker would disappear upon loading the game.
[*] Added Reinforced Hydraulic Rotator to the Store.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby renting Machines in the Heavy Equipment Park would be blocked on the gamepad.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby pouring water from the Bucket to the Hog Pan Pump wouldn't wash out the dirt.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby Bank loan wouldn't work on the gamepad.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby the Toolbox would appear when pressing [Z] on the keyboard while using a vehicle.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby it was possible to pick up and replace Miners Moss from the Sluicebox without removing Miners Grill First.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby Engine's sound wouldn't play after quick-loading.
[*] Corrected information about Easy Washplant Placing when starting a new game on Normal and Hard. It is now marked as "Off/Blocked".
[*] Disabled all remaining Steam Cloud Synch options, that could cause the game to crash.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby lifting the Shaker wouldn't be possible when attaching cables on top.
[*] Some Tutorial quest values are now calculated based on maximum summer prices, to avoid situation in which the player gathers less money than necessary to purchase all the equipment.
[*] Fixed an issue on the laptop whereby Used Slots counter on the claim would reset each time the player makes a purchase.
[*] Added marker to the Tutorial's Small Water Pump task.
[*] Removed unnecessary consumption values from certain items in the Store.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby pressing [Z] while creating a Save would open keybindings bar.
[*] Corrected Low Voltage Extension Cord texture.
[*] Corrected Handbrake prompt.
[*] Corrected some windows' textures.
[*] Added missing prompt to the Tutorials' last prologue task.
[*] Darkened tire marks on claims to fit the others.
[*] fixed an issue whereby Store Quantity values would remain visible after the purchase.
[*] Blocked possibility to enable Mouse Digging Mode in Tutorial's prologue.
[*] Other minor UI fixes.
[*] Updated translations.
[/list]

[h1]Thank you![/h1]
We'd like to thank all players who send us reports and suggestions. Thanks to you, this changelog is so rich. Another round for applause for community translators, who keep the game localized in your languages. You're awesome!

[h1]Feedback[/h1]
If you stumbled upon a bug in Gold Rush, please report it to us, by sending an e-mail to bugs@goldrush-thagame.com or by starting a new thread on Steam discussions:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/451340/discussions/2/

Also, your reviews are extremely important to us. If you haven't done it yet, we'd be grateful if you could drop us a review on Gold Rush Steam page.

[h1][b]Now let's get digging![/b][/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/451340/Gold_Rush_The_Game/

notes.title: Update 1.5.4 is LIVE - Light System Trailer, Leaderboards, and more!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33009884/a92dcc85d6bbdf0e30d977138fc22fb526bea715.png[/img]

[h1][b]Hello Miners![/b][/h1]
Update 1.5.4 is LIVE and it brings:
[list]
[*] Light System Trailer
[*] Leaderboards Season 3
[*] Workers Experience
[*] Store Sales
[*] Retraining Workers - choice of specialization
[/list]

[h1]Check out the Season 3 trailer:[/h1]
https://youtu.be/fXSP7OB5uEQ
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33009884/cd38913e6a681f0da8c7087fd0b6d0b1d6689588.png[/img]
[h1]Light System Trailer[/h1]
Dig the gold all day and all night with the brand new Light System Trailer. Auto-leveling mobile diesel trailer will let you extend and rotate its arm to light up your claim.
The extendable arm has 2 thresholds. The second threshold (>50%) is available when the trailer is in the deploy mode.  The trailer can't be attached to the pickup in the deploy mode. It is possible to rotate the lights in any mode. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33009884/212394ec7cac92231b45b42684d127be68b7adb0.png[/img]
[h1]Leaderboards Season 3[/h1]
Ready your shovel and prepare for an adventure. Show your gold mining skills and compete in two leaderboard modes: Max Gold (the total amount of Gold dug), Season Gold (the best Gold per Season ration). There is a price to dig for: the unique Excavator skin.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33009884/5ca49bc00f6beeaddacc857d8c7f1796cdfa6730.png[/img]
[h1]Workers Experience[/h1]
Workers can now get more skilled with time! For each working day at your gold mine (counted on midnight), they gain +1% performance. When the worker reaches maximum performance for a particular Tier, the Upgrade option is unlocked, which allows upgrading the worker to the next Tier. The Upgrade itself doesn't increase the performance.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33009884/f0af614097386c956e51614538c0882b89f19fe0.jpg[/img]
[h1]Store Sales[/h1]
Once in every 1-3 days, a random part in each store will be on sale. The sales are independent for both stores (machines and equipment) and can happen on different days. Items are on sale only in physical stores (in other words: there will be no discounts on the laptop).
Discount range:
• Machine Store - 10-25%
• Equipment Store - 15-30%
Players will be informed about the sale via prompt (upper left) with information about items name and discount.

[h1]Full changelog:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added Light System Trailer (described above).
[*] Leaderboards Season 3 started.
[*] Added Store Sales (described above).
[*] Added Worker's Experience (described above).
[*] Retraining Workers is no longer random. When selecting the Retrain option, a specializations list will appear. Each specialization has a different price - the more complex the machine, the higher the price. If the worker was on a higher Tier than the 1st one, he/she will lose the percentage of performance equal to one Tier.
[*] Added option to rent machines. The daily cost of renting is equal to the 1/25 of the machine's current price. To return the machine, the player must sell it.
[*] Added possibility to order drill services on random spots via Laptop.
[*] Added possibility to sleep for a particular number of hours.
[*] If not used, Batteries now lose durability during winter.
[*] Added maximum length value to hoses' UI icons.
[*] Icons of broken parts now also appear over broken parts, which lay on the ground.
[*] Reworked particle effects of campfire and machines smoke.
[*] Reordered some tutorial tasks.
[*] Removed the branch near the campfire at the Old Arnold claim.
[*] Fixes of achievements, which rely on statistics.
[*] Fixed gold nuggets bug, which prevented some of them from being picked during panning.
[*] Fixed Warehouse checkout bug on the laptop.
[*] Fixed Pickup Truck's reversing lights, which worked when the engine was off.
[*] Corrected valve's turning sound.
[*] UI fixes.
[*] Added unique Dump Truck skin to TOP10 Leaderboards players accounts.
[*] Updated Unity engine.
[*] Updated translations.
[*] Updated credits.
[/list]
[h1]Thank you![/h1]
We'd like to again thank all beta testers, whose specific reports and clever suggestions allowed us to make this update even better. Another round for applause for community translators, who keep the game localized in your languages. You're awesome!

[h1]Feedback[/h1]
If you stumbled upon a bug in Gold Rush, please report it to us, by sending an e-mail to bugs@goldrush-thagame.com or by starting a new thread on Steam discussions:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/451340/discussions/2/

Also, your reviews are extremely important to us. If you haven't done it yet, we'd be grateful if you could drop us a review on Gold Rush Steam page.

[h1][b]Now let's get digging[/b]![/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/451340/Gold_Rush_The_Game/

notes.title: AMD crashes since last update - help us solve the issue!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Players![/b][/h1]

We are aware that some of you might be experiencing crashes since the last Update. From your reports, we are able to suspect it has something to do with AMD Radeon GPUs and new Unity update. We're now in contact with AMD to resolve this issue.
To help us deal with the problem, we'd kindly ask those of you who have AMD Radeon GPUs to send us an e-mail at bugs@goldrush-thegame.com (Title: [i]AMD Crash[/i]) with the following files:
- output_log, 
- error.log, 
- crash.dmp,
- video of the crash.

Here's how to find them:

[b]Output_log[/b]
• Press the Windows key and R to bring up the 'Run' box.
• Enter the following without the quotes '%userprofile%\AppData\LocalLow\CodeHorizon\GoldRushTheGame'

[b]Error.log, crash.dmp[/b]
Once the game crashes, it will provide a log file, which can be found by following the steps below:
• Press the Windows key and R to bring up the 'Run' box.
• Enter the following without the quotation marks: "%userprofile%\AppData\LocalLow\CodeHorizon\GoldRushTheGame\Crashes"
• The crash folder will have the name of a date for example - 2018-02-12_151020 
Important: restarting the game will delete the crash log files.

or alternatively:
• Press the Windows key and R to bring up the 'Run' box.
• Enter the following without the quotation marks: "%temp%\CodeHorizon\GoldRushTheGame\Crashes"

[b]Video of the crash[/b]
Videos can be recorded with popular recording software such as OBS, Xsplit, AMD ReLive, etc.
You can upload the videos on wetransfer.com (or other services) and send us the link.

Thanks in advance for your help! With such files, it will be easier for us to help.

[b]Cheers![/b]

notes.title: Update 1.5.3 is LIVE - Leaderboards 2, new item, tool, worker, reinforced parts, and more!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Gold Miners![/h1]
Update 1.5.3 is [b]LIVE[/b] and it brings:
[list]
[*]Leaderboards Season 2
[*]Overseer
[*]Reinforced Parts
[*]Transport Crate
[*]Parts Analyzer
[*]New random events
[*]Balance changes
[*]Internet radio integration
[*]And more!
[/list]

[h1]Watch the trailer:[/h1]
https://youtu.be/mJvlKaZNAZo

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33009884/095ed477482fba6a5c96b1b70bc6832873fcd440.gif[/img]
[h1]Leaderboards Season 2[/h1]
Compete against other Players to become one of the greatest mine bosses! Now with the new [i]Seasonal Gold[/i] parameter.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/b906a29174ecd4313cc9ca6516057ea04f096f00.gif[/img]
[h1]Overseer[/h1]
The new worker is here to help you manage your gold mine more effectively. Get notifications when parts reach low durability or when Wash Plant elements (like mats) are full. Find out more about Tier 1-3 effects below.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/6486d92ba12caace92a37a96a2016a0b6e72ca82.gif[/img]
[h1]Reinforced Parts[/h1]
All breakable parts received their reinforced substitutes. They last longer, but come with greater costs.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/308dc783c9987c3160458e8e529fec0598d6705c.gif[/img]
[h1]Transport Crate[/h1]
Meet the Transport Crate - the greatest convenience item since the invention of the microwave. With this new equipment, you will be able to hold and carry multiple items at once.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/9d3f8bd65db91f94742dfac63ae7ffe644e49b97.gif[/img]
[h1]Parts Analyzer[/h1]
Allows you to easily check the current durability of selected parts. Simply approach the working machine and select Parts Analyzer.

[h1]Internet Radio integration[/h1]
Listen to your favorite streaming radios while digging!
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1714102451
[h1][b]Changes:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Added the reinforced set of breakable parts, which have greater durability, but also a greater price. They can be distinguished by a different color. Players can now choose to use more expensive parts, which will last longer. Reinforced parts are available in the Store.
[*]Added Wooden Crates. Players can use them to carry multiple items at the same time.
[*]Added new Tool: Parts Analyzer, which can be used to check the durability of the part it points at.
[*]Added new Worker: Overseer (see Tier 1-3 effects below).
[*]Added new random events (see the full list below).
[*]Added internet radio integration. Check out the guide above to learn how to activate it.
[*]Pickup Truck is now moved next to the player after being teleported to the Hotel when Permafrost hits.
[*]Pickup Truck no longer breaks when the Permafrost hits.
[*]The Headlight lightning now works as Flashlight, but with greater brightness. You can carry the equipment with the Headlight on.
[*]Removed Flashlight from the toolbar.
[*]Changed default Tools' changing to mouse's scroll wheel.
[*]Magnetite Separator stops processing dirt when the bucket is full (just like the Gold Nuggetator).
[*]Added 12-hour game time display option in the Settings -> Game -> Clock Time.
[*]Added information about the fuel consumption to the Store.
[*]Added a new button to the Generator: Start All.
[*]Workers are paid at midnight.
[*]Loan daily payments are collected at midnight.
[*]Statistics are checked at midnight, no matter at what time they are displayed to the Player.
[*]The randomization of workers in Retrain Workers option now works as drawing a new one (from the pool of available machines).
[*]Added the possibility of the Fuel Station running out of fuel.
[*]Added prompt informing about the engine being turned off when trying to use Excavator's arm.
[*]Made it possible to enter the Power Generator without jumping.
[*]Changed Map's moving icons.
[*]Added new valves to Water Towers. 
[*]Adjusted pan's collider to fit the bowl more accurately.
[*]Added Fuel Tank's opening sound.
[*]Added the possibility to open Fuel Tank's cap.
[*]Small Electric Water Pump's cap is now automatically opened before refueling.
[*]Added closing animations to lids and caps.
[*]Added new notification when the engine has been turned off but the lights are still on.
[*]Changed Magnetite's selling prompt text.
[*]Reduced the required amount of cables being attached in one of the Tutorial tasks from 4 to 3.
[*]Changed Wash Plant's elements snapping during setup on the Easy Mode. The correct rotation of the element is no longer necessary.
[*]Added more markers in the Tutorial to the Trommel, the Bank during the [*]Claim upgrade task, the Front-End Loader, Duplex Jig buckets, and ST Sluicebox buckets.
[*]Added new Tutorial task, which requires Players to sell the Gold Bar in the Tutorial.
[*]Changed wording in keybindings for the Excavator: one part of the Bucket has been renamed to Thumb, Big Arm to Boom, and Small Arm to Stick.
[*]Adjusted tree branch on Old Arnold's small digging site.
[*]Added Tool icons and associated keybindings to the in-game Show Controls menu.
[*]Limited fuel stations nozzle's hose length.
[*]Disabled random events in the tutorial.
[*]ST Sluicebox is now the first equipment to be set up in the tutorial.
[*]Pickup Truck no longer uses fuel in the tutorial until the first refueling.
[*]Added Romanian Pickup Truck skin.
[*]Added Leaderboards Pickup Truck skin to Top10 Players accounts.
[/list]

[h1][b]Leaderboards Season 2[/b][/h1]
For the second season of gold mining competition, we are adding a new parameter: best Gold per Season ratio ([i]Seasonal Gold[/i]). The game will count the highest amount of gold dug during any of the in-game seasons (full year). The score will be updated whenever Player gets a better score, so it will be continuously updated during the first in-game season, and then it will start updating again when Player reaches better score than during the first in-game season.
In other words, Players will now be competing in two leaderboards ([i]Max Gold[/i] and [i]Seasonal Gold[/i]), and the TOP10 lists may differ depending on the parameter. Winners will again be rewarded with a new special vehicle skin.
[list]
[*] In Leaderboards Mode, the gold gathered in buckets will be counted towards the current season's  Seasonal Gold value. This will prevent gold from being stored in buckets for the subsequent seasons in order to get better results.
[*] Added option to switch the display between to parameters: Overall Amount of Gold Dug and Gold/Season Ratio.
[*] Leaderboards are now scrollable.
[/list]

[h1][b]Overseer:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Tier 1:[/b] Shows notification when the part reaches 0.3 durability. Adds a Yellow version of the outline when below 0.3 and not yet destroyed (if Overseer's performance equals 100%). Prevents equipment theft random event from happening.
[*][b]Tier 2:[/b] Adds Red ray over the destroyed machine to be more noticeable from far away. Increases the Outline visibility range of destroyed/almost destroyed parts by x2,5 (if Overseer's performance equals 100%). Decreases the chance of bear attacking the cables and workers by 50% (if Overseer's performance equals 100%).
[*][b]Tier 3:[/b] Adds notification when any element of the Wash Plant system is full. Makes parts outline gradually change their color depending on their current durability. Decreases the chance of bear attacking the cables and workers by 100% (if Overseer's performance equals 100%).
[/list]

[h1][b]New random events[/b][/h1]
Every day there's a 5% chance that one of the new random events will occur at 4 am (or when the Player gets up). Each of the events has its own chance factor of happening, meaning that if a random event is triggered, some events will be more likely to occur than others:
[list]
[*]Theft of a single random part from a machine - 10%.
[*]Destruction of a single part from a machine - 10%.
[*]Theft of the fuel (emptying the fuel tank) - 15%.
[*]A single random employee quits - 25%.
[*]Theft of 5% of gathered Gold (gathered during a single day) - 10%.
[*]Theft of 10% of earned Money - 0% (the event can no longer happen).
[*]Laptop's malfunction - it does not work for a single day - 25%.
[*]No fuel on the Fuel Station - not possible to use it for a single day - 5%.
[/list]
In other words: there is a 5% chance every day that a random event will occur. If it does, there is a 25% chance that it will be a laptop's malfunction, 10% chance that it will be a Part's Theft, etc.

notes.title: Leaderboards Season 02 - Starting Soon!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/354bbdcb37e1cc91fa79ec04264dd95ae6630df5.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Hello Miners![/b][/h1]
Leaderboards Seasons 02 will start on [b]April 16[/b] (Tuesday)!

For the second season of gold mining competition, we are adding a new parameter: best Gold per Season ratio ([i]Seasonal Gold[/i]). The game will count the highest amount of gold dug during any of the in-game seasons (full year). The score will be updated whenever Player gets a better score, so it will be continuously updated during the first in-game season, and then it will start updating again when Player reaches better score than during the first in-game season.

In other words, Players will now be competing in two leaderboards ([i]Max Gold[/i] and [i]Seasonal Gold[/i]), and the TOP10 lists may differ depending on the parameter. Winners will again be rewarded with a new special vehicle skin.

[b]Prepare yourselves![/b]

notes.title: Open Beta Update 1.5.3 - New item, tool, worker, reinforced parts, and more!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/f3b2995d2a0ae2588c8452c9ca05fc52b0c5c864.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Update 1.5.3 Open Beta is here![/b][/h1]
Try out new content before the release.

[b]What's new:[/b]
[list]
[*]Overseer
[*]Reinforced Parts
[*]Transport Crate
[*]Parts Analyzer
[*]New random events
[*]Balance changes
[*]And more!
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/b906a29174ecd4313cc9ca6516057ea04f096f00.gif[/img]
[h1]Overseer[/h1]
The new worker is here to help you manage your gold mine more effectively. Get notifications when parts reach low durability or when Wash Plant elements (like mats) are full. Find out more about Tier 1-3 effects below.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/6486d92ba12caace92a37a96a2016a0b6e72ca82.gif[/img]
[h1]Reinforced Parts[/h1]
All breakable parts received their reinforced substitutes. They last longer, but come with greater costs.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/308dc783c9987c3160458e8e529fec0598d6705c.gif[/img]
[h1]Transport Crate[/h1]
Meet the Transport Crate - the greatest convenience item since the invention of the microwave. With this new equipment, you will be able to hold and carry multiple items at once.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/9d3f8bd65db91f94742dfac63ae7ffe644e49b97.gif[/img]
[h1]Parts Analyzer[/h1]
Allows you to easily check the current durability of selected parts. Simply approach the working machine and select Parts Analyzer.

[h1][b]Changes:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Added the reinforced set of breakable parts, which have greater durability, but also a greater price. They can be distinguished by a different color. Players can now choose to use more expensive parts, which will last longer. Reinforced parts are available in the Store.
[*]Added Wooden Crates. Players can use them to carry multiple items at the same time.
[*]Added new Tool: Parts Analyzer, which can be used to check the durability of the part it points at.
[*]Added new Worker: Overseer (see Tier 1-3 effects below).
[*]Added new random events (see the full list below).
[*]Pickup Truck is now moved next to the player after being teleported to the Hotel when Permafrost hits.
[*]Pickup Truck no longer breaks when the Permafrost hits.
[*]The Headlight lightning now works as Flashlight, but with greater brightness. You can carry the equipment with the Headlight on.
[*]Removed Flashlight from the toolbar.
[*]Magnetite Separator stops processing dirt when the bucket is full (just like the Gold Nuggetator).
[*]Added 12-hour game time display option in the Settings -> Game -> Clock Time.
[*]Added information about fuel consumption to the Store.
[*]Added a new button to the Generator: Start All.
[*]Workers are paid at midnight.
[*]Loan daily payments are collected at midnight.
[*]Statistics are checked at midnight, no matter at what time they are displayed to the Player.
[*]The randomization of workers in Retrain Workers option now works as drawing a new one (from the pool of available machines).
[*]Added the possibility of the Fuel Station running out of fuel.
[*]Added prompt informing about the engine being turned off when trying to use Excavator's arm.
[*]Changed Map's moving icons.
[*]Added new valves to Water Towers. 
[*]Adjusted pan's collider to fit the bowl more accurately.
[*]Added Fuel Tank's opening sound.
[*]Added the possibility to open Fuel Tank's cap.
[*]Small Electric Water Pump's cap is now automatically opened before refueling.
[*]Added closing animations to lids and caps.
[*]Added new notification when the engine has been turned off but the lights are still on.
[*]Changed Magnetite's selling prompt text.
[*]Reduced the required amount of cables being attached in one of the Tutorial tasks from 4 to 3.
[*]Changed Wash Plant's elements snapping during setup on the Easy Mode. The correct rotation of the element is no longer necessary.
[*]Added more markers in the Tutorial to the Trommel, the Bank during the [*]Claim upgrade task, the Front-End Loader, Duplex Jig buckets, and ST Sluicebox buckets.
[*]Added new Tutorial task, which requires Players to sell the Gold Bar in the Tutorial.
[*]Changed wording in keybindings for the Excavator: one part of the Bucket has been renamed to Thumb, Big Arm to Boom, and Small Arm to Stick.
[*]Added Tool icons and associated keybindings to the in-game Show Controls menu.
[*]Added Romanian Pickup Truck skin.
[*]Added Leaderboards Pickup Truck skin to Top10 Players accounts.
[/list]

[h1][b]Overseer:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Tier 1:[/b] Shows notification when the part reaches 0.3 durability. Adds a Yellow version of the outline when below 0.3 and not yet destroyed (if Overseer's performance equals 100%).
[*][b]Tier 2:[/b] Adds Red ray over the destroyed machine to be more noticeable from far away. Increases the Outline visibility range of destroyed/almost destroyed parts by x2,5 (if Overseer's performance equals 100%). Decreases the chance of bear attacking the cables and workers by 50% (if Overseer's performance equals 100%).
[*][b]Tier 3:[/b] Adds notification when any element of the Wash Plant system is full. Makes parts outline gradually change their color depending on their current durability. Decreases the chance of bear attacking the cables and workers by 100% (if Overseer's performance equals 100%).
[/list]

[h1][b]New random events[/b][/h1]
Every day there's a 1% chance that one of the following random events will happen at 4 am (or when the Player gets up):
[list]
[*]Theft of a single random part.
[*]Destruction of a single part.
[*]Theft of the fuel (emptying the fuel tank)
[*]A single random employee quits.
[*]Theft of 10% of gathered Gold.
[*]Theft of 10% of earned Money.
[*]Laptop's malfunction - it does not work for a single day.
[*]No fuel on the Fuel Station - not possible to use it for a single day.
[/list]

[h1][b]Balance:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Decreased Bank loan interest rate.
[*]Decreased Excavator's fuel usage.
[*]Increased Front-End Loader's fuel usage.
[*]Increased Excavator's Bucket size.
[*]Increased Big Excavator's movement by 15%.
[*]Increased Big Excavator's hydraulic speed by 10%.
[*]Decreased Big Excavator's price.
[*]Decreased Front-End Loader's reverse movement speed by 20%.
[*]Decreased Front-End Loader's bucket size.
[*]Increased Front-End Loader's price.
[*]Decreased Bulldozer's fuel consumption.
[*]Decreased Bulldozer's price.
[*]Increased T4 and T5 equipment prices.
[*]Increased Frankenstein's price.
[*]Decreased Dump Truck's price.
[*]Increased Excavator Teeth's durability.
[*]Increased Wheels' durability.
[*]Increased Hydraulic Hoses' durability (for the Bulldozer, Small Excavator, and Big Excavator).
[*]Increased Battery's durability.
[*]Increased Magnetite Separator's Hose durability.
[*]Increased Wave Table's Jets durability.
[*]Increased River's water pressure distance.
[*]Increased Blacksmith upgrades' price.
[*]Increased Water's price.
[*]Increased Gold Nugettator's price.
[*]Increased the amount of gold at Rich Spots on claims.
[*]Decreased the amount of gold at regular spots on claims.
[*]Increased claims' rent prices (except Old Arnold's).
[*]Increased claims' prices.
[*]Decreased claims' rent provision rate (except Old Arnold's).
[*]Decreased the frequency of breakdowns on Normal difficulty.
[*]Decreased Mobile Wash Plant Worker's cost multiplier.
[*]Increased ST Sluicebox Worker's cost multiplier.
[*]Increased T-DJ Sluicebox Worker's cost multiplier.
[*]Decreased Bulldozer Worker's cost multiplier.
[*]Increased Drill Worker's cost multiplier.
[*]Increased Mechanic's cost multiplier.
[*]Mechanic now charges X percent of particular part's cost for X percent of the part fixed. There is no longer a flat rate per the percentage of the part fixed.
[*]Decreased Worker's retraining cost.
[*]Decreased the chance of bear attacking the cable.
[*]Minor Tutorial balance changes.
[/list]

[h1][b]Fixes & Optimization:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Added culling to machines, which are out of sight (optimization). 
[*]Disabled Trommel, Shaker, and Duplex Jig animations when out of sight (optimization).
[*]Reduced machine computations for the machines, which are currently not being used (optimization).
[*]Hoses and cables optimization.
[*]Fixed blinking tree shadows.
[*]Trees' shadows are now dependent on graphics settings.
[*]Fixed gold bar purchase double-press bug on a gamepad.
[*]Fixed option to close Laptop by pressing [B] on a gamepad.
[*]Fixed Laptop's purchase prompt on a gamepad.
[*]Fixed bug with inability to leave DigTube after loading the game on a gamepad.
[*]Fixed Map's square selection bug on a gamepad.
[*]Corrected duplicated button icon on New Normal Mode popup window on a gamepad.
[*]Fixed bug with Frankenstein's belt running when holding the belt's in or out button while exiting the machine.
[*]Fixed Pickup Truck's Camo skin.
[*]Added water consumption to all applicable parts in the Store.
[*]Fixed Rivertown's collapsing Water Tower bug on old save game files.
[*]Corrected displayed text format when selling gold.
[*]Corrected displayed text format when selling magnetite.
[*]Fixed Excavator's levers UI panel when using a mouse.
[*]Corrected "Previous item" icon in the in-game controls scheme.
[*]Corrected discarding options window.
[*]Fixed bug with the ripple effect of water affecting UI equipment indicators.
[*]Corrected hoses' colliders in the tent.
[*]Removed unnecessary antialiasing option.
[*]Fixed Wash Plant Spring's outline in the Warehouse.
[*]Fixed Equipment Store's price bug in the Tutorial.
[*]Fixed Claim resetting's UI dots bug.
[*]Fixed Shovel's UI blocking bug when opening the Main Meu during animation.
[*]Fixed bank loan prompt bug.
[*]Fixed DigTube's bug which didn't play properly if New Normal Mode window popped up before it.
[*]Blocked possibility to enter shopping cart in the Warehouse, when it's empty.
[*]Fixed Blacksmith's upgrade visual bug.
[*]Fixed Laptop notifications unlock bug.
[*]Corrected Hog Pan's third Mat selection.
[*]Corrected Heavy Equipment Store specifications.
[*]Corrected Paint shop icons.
[*]Disabled "Fire the employee" option when using the gamepad if there are no Workers hired.
[*]Added missing material to the broken cable.
[*]Fixed reverse Water Tower text bug.
[*]Fixed Water Splitters minor bugs.
[*]Various Laptop UI fixes.
[*]Various Blacksmith UI fixes.
[*]Various Bank UI fixes.
[*]Various other UI fixes.
[/list]

[h1]How to switch to open beta branch:[/h1]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1346397630

[h1][b]IMPORTANT[/b][/h1]
Open Beta branch is a voluntary option and it may not reflect the quality and content of actual Update 1.5.3.
Save files from Open Beta version won't be transferred to a live build.

[h1]Discussions[/h1]
To discuss topics related to Open Beta Update 1.5.3, please create a thread in Open Beta 1.5.3 forums:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/451340/discussions/12/

[h1]Reviews[/h1]
Your reviews are extremely important to us. If you haven't done it yet, we'd be grateful if you could leave a review on Gold Rush Steam page.

[h1][b]Now let's get digging![/b][/h1]

notes.content:

[h1]Hello Gold Miners![/h1]
Update 1.5.2 is LIVE and it brings:
[list]
[*]Leaderboards
[*]New and updated national skins for Pickup Truck
[*]and more!
[/list]
Full [b]changelog[/b] below.

[h1]Watch trailer:[/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dc0sjU1LPSc

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/8f8ce2bacf7fd72c5b84632a7af7276b17d1d294.png[/img]
[h1]Leaderboards[/h1]
Just as Gold Rush TV Series mine bosses you can now compare your gold totals with other players in Leaderboards!
Start playing in new Leaderboards mode and earn your place in rankings.
[b]Good to know:[/b]
[list]
[*]Balance values are drawn from the New Normal Mode.
[*]Player's score shows the total amount of gold dug and real-life playing time spent to achieve it.
[*]Score sums the amount of gold dug in consecutive in-game seasons.
[*]Leaderboards will be reset from time to time, but the history of previous seasons will remain (top players + player's score).
[*]You can get a special reward (vehicle skin) for being one of the top players in Leaderboards.
[*]Save files from non-active (reset) Leaderboards will become Normal Mode saves and you will be able to continue playing on that save file.
[*]It's not possible to share save file from active Leaderboards.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/619e3fdbbe2a9837a69b5de6e73d4a1e97c21956.gif[/img]
[h1]New and updated national skins for Pickup Truck[/h1]
Did you know, that most of translations are made by our awesome community members? ❤ We want to appreciate their hard work and devotion, by adding new Pickup Truck vehicle skins.
ps There will be at least one more added to the game in one of the upcoming updates: Romanian. @Jimmy - we didn't forget about you!

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added Leaderboards mode.
[*]Added Leaderboards tab in Leaderboards mode for players to compare their total amount of gold dug.
[*]Added new and updated existing Pickup Truck's national flag vehicle skins.
[*]Changed balance values for Normal Mode. It used to have the same values as Easy Mode, but now it's more balanced between Easy and Hard Modes.  Players will have a single opportunity to decide, whether they want to switch to New Normal Mode or switch to Easy Mode (which has the same balance values as previous Normal Mode).
[*]Workers now only apply to work on machines, which player currently possesses.
[*]Blocked possibility to quick-load the game when it's saving.
[*]Increased Wave Table's capacity.
[*]Doubled Dump Truck's and Conveyor Belt's capacity.
[*]Increased Front-End Loader's hydraulic speed.
[*]All purchased machines start with 20% fuel.
[*]Added Mechanic icon above items that are currently being repaired by a Mechanic.
[*]Added provision for gold panning and washing dirt in the Wavetable when in Town.
[*]Frankenstein's Belt icon turns off on HUD when the fuel runs out in the second engine.
[*]Added new prompt informing about an empty fuel tank in Frankenstein's second engine.
[*]Increased Map's zoom in value.
[*]Updated Gold Rush posters and banners in Town and tent.
[*]Changed save files description to include difficulty level and season.
[*]Default keybindings are now displayed in Tutorial's prompts.
[*]Reversed Excavator's scoop keys in Tutorial's prompt.
[*]Added new Excavator digging prompts in the Tutorial.
[*]Changed prompt's background.
[*]Added background to Pressure System texts.
[*]Vehicle paint UI changes.
[*]Workers UI changes.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed Front-End Loader's bucket sticking to Dump Truck's bed.
[*]Mobile Washplant's indicators should no longer disappear after leaving the claim and going back from Town.
[*]Fixed Conveyor Belt's infinite energy exploit.
[*]Fixed bug with River not filling when the player is sleeping.
[*]Corrected Mobile Water Tank's button animation.
[*]Fixed camera's stutter when moving and rotating the camera.
[*]Fixed Pickup Truck's LOD.
[*]Fixed Hog Pan Core's worker bug - worker is now increasing the efficiency (amount of gold) instead of filling hog pan mats faster.
[*]Fixed inability to finish the tutorial if unlocking all laptop tabs on 1$ mode before receiving the appropriate quest task.
[*]Fixed bug with birds' sounds not being played during summer.
[*]Fixed Mobile Water Tank's steering.
[*]Fixed inability to switch camera and vehicle when reaching Season 10.
[*]Fixed Magnetite Separator's particles.
[*]Fixed prompt's issue with the first gold nugget having 0.66 at the end.
[*]Fixed bug with Sluicebox Grates disappearing after loading the game if not attached to Sluicebox.
[*]Fixed End-of-the-year summary statistics bug.
[*]Fixed bug with 1,111 value on Small Water Pump.
[*]Fixed walking sound in the night on asphalt.
[*]Fixed driving sound in the night on asphalt.
[*]Fixed wheel's sound - it no longer plays broken wheel's sound when repaired.
[*]Fixed Magnetite Trailer exploit with unprocessed dirt.
[*]Fixed Sluicebox Grate LOD.
[*]Fixed sound of nugget dropped to a jar.
[*]Fixed Excavator's Arm sound.
[*]Fixed notifications prompt.
[*]Fixed Drill's LOD - it should no longer glow
[*]Fixed Mobile Washplant's blinking icons.
[*]Fixed fuel usage bug.
[*]Gamepad UI fixes
[*]Minor optimization improvements.
[*]Other Leaderboards UI changes & fixes.
[/list]

[h1]Thank you![/h1]
We'd like to thank all beta testers, who helped us polish this update. Your suggestions were well-aimed and your reports - specific. You're awesome!

[h1]Feedback[/h1]
If you stumbled upon a bug in Gold Rush, please report it to us, by sending an e-mail to bugs@goldrush-thagame.com or by starting a new thread on Steam discussions:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/451340/discussions/2/
Your reviews are extremely important to us. If you haven't done it, we'd be grateful if you could leave a review on Gold Rush Steam page.

[h1]Now let's get digging![/h1]
