[h1]Happy Holidays Prospectors![/h1]
We wish you all the best and have a little gift for you.
Gold Rush: The Game has just been updated with:

[h1]Changelog:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Implemented Water Pressure System.
[*]Implemented Electrical Power System.
[*]Added Mobile Water Tank to the shop.
[*]Added Water Towers to claims. Each Water Tower (apart from the one in town) costs 150,000$ to build. Refilling the Tower costs money, but it has two hose inputs (medium and large) so it can be additionally supplied with water from the River.
[*]Added Water Tower with infinite water in Town.
[*]The River is now affected by Summer and Winter conditions.  It dries out when the temperature is higher than 25 Celsius degrees and freezes when the temperature is lower than -2 Celsius degrees (the effect is not immediate).

[*]Mobile Washplant's Performance increased.
[*]Big Water Pump can move water from the River.
[*]Increased the amount of gold dug at the bottom of the ground.
[*]Fixed Bulldozer's missing wheel.

notes.title: Update 1.5.1 is LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/2b1af121c49cd6829b110ce33a01f1cb8d2f4f52.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hello Prospectors![/h1]
Update 1.5.1.11018 is LIVE and it brings:
[list]
[*]Balance Changes (improved digging)
[*]Tutorial Improvements
[*]Bug Fixes
[*]And more.
[/list]
Full [b]changelog[/b] below.

[h1]IMPORTANT:[/h1] We had to [b]temporarily disable the Steam Cloud Synchronization[/b] due to an issue with the deleted save files reported by some Players. We are now investigating the issue and hope to fix it in the coming days. For now, please remember to copy your save files if you wish to transfer them to another drive.
Here's how to find them:
[list]
[*]Press the Windows key and R to bring up the 'Run' box.
[*]Enter the following without the quotes: '%userprofile%\AppData\LocalLow\CodeHorizon\GoldRushTheGame\Saves'
[*]Copy the content of the entire folder.
[/list]

[h1]Balance changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Changed Excavator's digging parameters. Digging feeling has changed.
[*]Changed Front-End Loader's digging parameters. Digging feeling has changed.
[*]Reduced Front-End ability to push dirt.
[*]Changed starting fuel of any machine to 20%.
[*]All washplant containers fill evenly at the same rate.
[*]Increased prices of T4 & T5 machines.
[*]Reduced claim upgrade prices.
[*]Changed shop prices.
[*]Changed machine park prices.
[*]Changed Seasons' price multiplier.
[*]Adjusted destroyable Parts lifetime.
[*]Changed the multiplier of failures during Summer and Winter.
[*]Lowered the multiplier of parts durability during Seasons on Hard Mode.
[*]Lowered the multiplier of Fuel price on Hard Mode.
[*]Other balance changes.
[/list]

[h1]Tutorial:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added Tier 2 tutorial.
[*]Added Tier 3 assembly tutorial.
[*]Added possibility to end the tutorial at any time (currently only on the keyboard).
[*]Added new tutorial steps to the existing quest tasks.
[*]Changed order of Small Excavator and Mobile Washplant quest tasks in the tutorial.
[*]Changed several tutorial quest task texts.
[*]Added new yellow markers (quest task indicators) to better guide the Player.
[*]Added more godrays (yellow beams) on the road to the Old Arnold claim.
[*]Adjusted existing yellow markers (quest task indicators) positions.
[*]Added yellow markers, which are displayed in the corner of the screen, if the godray is not visible in Players' sight.
[*]Changed headers of tutorial tasks (T1, T2, etc.).
[*]Disabled possibility to use the bucket on machines, that are not in quest task.
[*]Changed Tutorial starting season from Spring to Summer.
[*]Added new task after smelting first gold bar. Players are now required to get 20k dollars.
[*]Fueling quest tasks are skipped if the player has full fuel tanks.
[*]Quest tasks, which require to collect a specific amount of gold, are skipped if the player is playing with 1$ Mode enabled.
[*]Disabled the day summary at the beginning of the tutorial.
[*]Other minor tutorial fixes.
[/list]

[h1]Other:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Changed Stock graph in the Bank to better reflect the changes after Four Seasons Cycle Update. As each Season has 10 days, the Graph is now divided into 40 days.
[*]Name of the highlighted item is now displayed.
[*]Allowed Hog Pan Container worker to be assigned to Hog Pan No Pump.
[*]Added ladders to washplant areas on each claim to make it easier to reach ST sluiceboxes.
[*]Small Shovel is now third in order. Players can use it by pressing [3] key on keyboard.
[*]Added numbers under Tools icons.
[*]Added 'Stories' text to the icon.
[*]Changed category of Miners Moss and Hog Pan Mats to Accessories in the online shop.
[*]"Sell Gold Bar" button is now greyed out when there's no gold bar chosen.
[*]Removed popup window informing about the addition of Four Seson Cycle to the game.
[*]Added possibility to assign workers to the already assigned machines. They will be added instead of the previous worker.
[*]Included Backpack Key shortcut in the in-game "Show Controls" menu (under [Z] key). 
[*]Changed Gamepad scrolling in the online shop.
[*]Added "Back" button after choosing the game difficulty.
[*]Minor localization changes.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug with the game crashing during autosave.
[*]Optimization of scenes.
[*]Fixed bug, which prevented some players from continuing the tutorial after filling the hog pan up to 30%.
[*]Fixed blinking shadows on Ultra quality.
[*]Fixed double-clicking bug when selling gold bars in the Bank (only one click is required now).
[*]Fixed Frankenstein's belt bug.
[*]Added missing sound to Loans tab in the Bank.
[*]Fixed Gold Nugget notifications displaying in different units than the ones chosen in Settings.
[*]Fixed Frankenstein's collision after loading the save file.
[*]Fixed Rivertown's bedrock dirt bug (the dirt look like it's diggable, but it wasn't).
[*]Fixed Laptop's transport prompt.
[*]Mobile Washplant textures fixes.
[*]Fixed 0oz gold bar bug.
[*]Fixed bug which allowed to loan the same claim multiple times despite already renting it.
[*]FIxed bug, which allowed to add 0 amount of any machinery to the order and proceed with it to check out in the heavy machinery park.
[*]Removed snow texture from gold bars.
[*]Transport UI fixes.
[*]Minor SFX fixes.
[*]Minor UI fixes. 
[*]Minor localization fixes.
[/list]

[h1]Gamepad Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Disabled Dump Truck's bed moving with gamepad's stick.
[*]Added a slight cooldown on the gamepad for changing the number of items in the laptop (values no longer increase without limit when leaning the stick - the counter stops at some point).
[*]Fixed Front-End Loader's faulty bucket on the gamepad. It might be required to reset gamepad controls to default in game's settings.
[*]Fixed Transport bug on the gamepad, which prevented players from taking any actions, after transporting anything from the right side of the Transport menu. 
[*]Fixed bug with white squares displayed instead of button icons when returning from shop menus on the gamepad.
[*]Fixed gamepad controls when using the map for the first time.
[*]Fixed bug, which prevented players from renting parcels after switching back from the gamepad.
[*]Added possibility to upgrade workers on the gamepad.
[*]Added possibility to reject workers on the gamepad.
[*]Added possibility to assign workers on the gamepad.
[*]Added possibility to unselect workers on the gamepad.
[*]Fixed inability to move lists of items in online shop when using the gamepad.
[*]Added popup informing about rejecting workers application of firing a worker on the gamepad.
[*]Other minor gamepad UI fixes.
[/list]

[h1]Thank you![/h1]
We'd like to thank all beta testers, who helped us polish this update. Your suggestions were well-aimed and your reports - specific. You're awesome!

[h1]Roadmap and FAQ:[/h1]
https://goldrush-thegame.com

[h1]Feedback[/h1]
If you stumbled upon a bug in Gold Rush, please report it to us, by sending an e-mail to bugs@goldrush-thagame.com or by starting a new thread on Steam discussions:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/451340/discussions/2/
Your reviews are extremely important to us. If you haven't done it, we'd be grateful if you could leave a review on Gold Rush Steam page.

[h1]Now let's get digging![/h1]

[h1]Hello Miners![/h1]
We've just opened the Open Beta branch on Steam for you to check the upcoming update. We're mainly tweaking game's balance and tutorial.

Primarily, we've managed to change the digging's feeling of Front-End Loader and Excavator. We'd love to hear your opinions on the changes. You can help us make the game more enjoyable for you.
Once you give Open Beta Update a try, please join the discussion on our channels:
[list]

[*]Discord (#beta-general channel): https://discordapp.com/invite/goldrush-thegame

Save files from Open Beta version won't be transferred to a live build.

notes.title: Gold Rush: The Game - Anniversary Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33009884/cf74983acc8bc86dcff166d33bb02ead94f13118.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hello Players![/h1]
Gold Rush: The Game is celebrating it's 1st anniversary with a huge Anniversary Update, featuring:
[list]
[*]Four Seasons Cycle
[*]Achievements
[*]Reversed Tutorial
[*]and more!
[/list]

Full [b]changelog[/b] below.

[h1]Release trailer[/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jCLzQsaKpNQ

[h1]Four Seasons Cycle[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33009884/a52ca659afcfd02b6c23173a751a314161f06f0b.gif[/img]
Experience harsh Alaskan Winter and get excited about new gold mining season with the first Spring breeze.

[h1]Achievements[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33009884/86030107f49f08e7acc5e32046d83dcd6c49ad6d.gif[/img]
Show off your gold mining experience with Steam achievements. Can you get them all?

[h1]Reversed Tutorial[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33009884/a11e368687c7d3f860413a7119d266373e743ca9.gif[/img]
Start with all the best toys and... see for yourself!


[h1]Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Seasons - gameplay is now affected by weather conditions:
- Spring,
- Summer,
- Autumn,
- Winter.
(description of Seasons and weather conditions below)
[*]Spring, Summer, and Autumn last 10 in-game days.
[*]Winter can last up to 7 in-game days, but players can finish it earlier in the Hotel in town.
[*]Added story popup after moving to the hotel in Winter.
[*]After loading the old save file, players start at Season 3 Day 1 (Spring).
[*]Prices in Shop are changing with each passing day. Increasing towards Summer and decreasing towards Winter.
[*]Added Fahrenheit temperature scale. You can enable it, by switching Units Type to Imperial (in Settings).
[*]Added new HUD indicators:
- Season,
- weather,
- temperature,
- days till next Season.
[*]Added a new summary window of Days and Seasons.
[*]Added rewards (Jars of gold displayed in the Tent) for finishing each full gold mining season (from Spring to Winter). Maximum amount of jars is 7.
[*]Added weather-related prompts.
[*]Added Achievements (full list below).
[*]Changed existing Tutorial to Reversed Tutorial. From now on players start with Tier 3 equipment and learn basic gameplay mechanics.
[*]Difficulty modes added (accessible from 'New Game' in Main Menu):
- Easy,
- Normal,
- Hard,
- Leaderboards (coming soon).
[*]Difficulty modes' features descriptions are visible when starting New Game.
[*]Difficulty level can't be changed during the game.
[*]Added menu with level difficulty choice for old saves.
[*]Added information about overriding save files.
[*]Added Prompt informing about the necessity to turn the engine on when not being able to drive. It does not disappear until the engine is turned on.
[*]New epilepsy warning popup window.
[*]Added Cancel button to Main Menu.
[*]Collector's Edition Upgrade content is now accessible from Main Menu.
[*]Added Left and Right Trigger button icons to Main Menu.
[*]Added "Back" button to Journal.
[*]Added possibility to switch Journal bookmarks on a gamepad.
[*]Pressing [A] button on Play in Main Menu will move the active selection to the window below.
[*]Updated localizations.
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Stories Radar no longer locks when in Pickup Truck.
[*]Fixed menu background not blurring when changing controller buttons.
[*]DigTube UI fixes.
[*]Gamepad UI fixes.
[*]UI prompts fixes.
[*]Menu buttons UI fixes.
[*]Controls UI fixes (controller buttons should be displayed correctly after returning from Pause Menu).
[*]Added missing gamepad button icons (previously displayed as white squares).
[*]Journal gamepad fixes.
[/list]

[h1]Seasons description[/h1]
[b]Spring[/b]
[list]
[*]Big Repairs - If you haven't put your equipment to the hangar or transport storage space, you're in a bit of a hole... Everything that could be broken will be broken.
[*]Animal Attacks - From time to time an animal can attack your claim (Popup event). There is a chance that your employee will be attacked and will be inactive for a while (information will be displayed in the Workers tab on the laptop) or the animal can break your cables/hoses (you will need to replace them).
[*]Meltdown - Earth is still a bit frozen, so you need to use the ripper (Bulldozer's back) to cultivate the earth before digging. If the temperature is low, the earth should still freeze over time. If you would not use the ripper, you won't be able to dig.
[*]Prices - Regular prices in the shop. All prices will vary day to day across the season.
[/list]

[b]Summer[/b]
[list]
[*]High Temperature - What a blistering heat! Machines break faster.
[*]Fainting - Workers can faint and be inactive for a while.
[*]Prices - Higher prices in the shop.
[/list]

[b]Autumn[/b]
[list]
[*]Heavy Rain - Electrical equipment is breaking faster. Wash Plant is breaking faster because of the dense and wet earth. Vehicles have less traction.
[*]Storm - The Laptop is off (no signal).
[*]Thunderstruck - At the beginning of the storm, thunderstruck can hit your big generator. There is a chance for each part connected to break as a result.
[*]Prices - Regular prices in the shop.
[/list]

[b]Winter[/b]
[list]
[*]Permafrost - Earth is frozen. You need to use the ripper (Bulldozer's back) to cultivate the earth before digging. If you would not use the ripper, you won't be able to dig.
[*]Freeze - Vehicles are breaking way faster. When the temperature is very low, hoses can break if the connected equipment is turned off, but the water pump is still running. Workers can get sick and be inactive for a while.
[*]Fuel - Higher fuel usage.
[*]Prices - Lower prices in the shop.
[/list]

[b]Summary[/b]
When you try to end the gold mining season but left something outside the hangar, you will receive a prompt about not securing every breakable equipment.
A summary with all your stats will be displayed, after finishing the gold mining season at the Hotel (in the middle of Winter).
You won't be able to finish the season before the winter comes.
After ending the season there you will receive an additional small trophy (jar) with the amount of gold you've collected during the last gold mining season.

[h1]Achievements list[/h1]
https://steamcommunity.com/stats/451340/achievements

[h1]Thank you![/h1]
We want to thank all players, who helped us past those 365 days and supported us. We wouldn't be here without you!

[h1]Now let's get digging![/h1]

notes.title: Anniversary Update Open Beta - Seasons, Achievements, Reversed Tutorial
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29258259/221b70e10d839de5193ffb7cd51419c2efb51b72.jpg[/img]

[h1]Anniversary Update 1.5 Open Beta is here![/h1]
Try out Seasons, Achievements, Reversed Tutorial, and more before the release.

[b]Watch Teaser:[/b]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZkwnWl2uBGA

[h1]How to switch to open beta branch:[/h1]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1346397630

[h1]What's new?[/h1]
[b]Four Seasons Cycle.[/b]
Experience harsh Alaskan Winter and get excited about new gold mining season with the first Spring breeze.
[b]Achievements.[/b]
Show off your gold mining experience with Steam achievements. Can you get them all?
[b]Reversed Tutorial.[/b]
Start with all the best toys and... see for yourself!
[b]And More![/b]
New Game difficulty levels, bug fixes, and other improvements.

[h1]IMPORTANT[/h1]
Open Beta branch is a voluntary option and it may not reflect the quality and content of actual Anniversary Update 1.5.
Save files from Open Beta version won't be transferred to a live build.
Machine Failures are disabled by default. You need to enable them in Settings/Game.

[h1]Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Seasons - gameplay is now affected by weather conditions:
- Spring,
- Summer,
- Autumn,
- Winter.
(description of Seasons and weather conditions below)
[*]Spring, Summer, and Autumn last 7 in-game days.
[*]Winter can last up to 5 in-game days, but players can finish it earlier in the Hotel in town.
[*]Prices in Shop are changing with each passing day. Increasing towards Summer and decreasing towards Winter.
[*]Added new HUD indicators:
- Season,
- weather,
- temperature,
- days till next Season.
[*]Added a new summary window of Days and Seasons.
[*]Added rewards (Jars of gold displayed in the Tent) for finishing each full gold mining season (from Spring to Winter).
[*]Added weather-related prompts.
[*]Added Achievements (full list below).
[*]Difficulty modes added (accessible from 'New Game' in Main Menu):
- Easy,
- Normal,
- Hard,
- Leaderboards (coming soon).
[*]Difficulty level can't be changed during the game.
[*]Added Prompt informing about the necessity to turn the engine on when not being able to drive.
[*]New epilepsy warning popup window.
[*]Added Cancel button to Main Menu.
[*]Collector's Edition Upgrade content is now accessible from Main Menu.
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Stories Radar no longer locks when in Pickup Truck.
[*]Fixed menu background not blurring when changing controller buttons.
[*]DigTube UI fixes.
[*]Gamepad UI fixes.
[*]UI prompts fixes.
[*]Menu buttons UI fixes.
[/list]

[h1]Seasons description[/h1]
[b]Spring[/b]
[list]
[*]Big Repairs - If you haven't put your equipment to the hangar or transport storage space, you're in a bit of a hole... Everything that could be broken will be broken.
[*]Animal Attacks - From time to time an animal can attack your claim (Popup event). There is a chance that your employee will be attacked and will be inactive for a while (information will be displayed in the Workers tab on the laptop) or the animal can break your cables/hoses (you will need to replace them).
[*]Meltdown - Earth is still a bit frozen, so you need to use the ripper (Bulldozer's back) to cultivate the earth before digging. If the temperature is low, the earth should still freeze over time. If you would not use the ripper, you won't be able to dig.
[*]Prices - Regular prices in the shop. All prices will vary day to day across the season.
[/list]

[b]Summer[/b]
[list]
[*]High Temperature - What a blistering heat! Machines break faster.
[*]Fainting - Workers can faint and be inactive for a while.
[*]Prices - Higher prices in the shop.
[/list]

[b]Autumn[/b]
[list]
[*]Heavy Rain - Electrical equipment is breaking faster. Wash Plant is breaking faster because of the dense and wet earth. Vehicles have less traction.
[*]Storm - The Laptop is off (no signal).
[*]Thunderstruck - At the beginning of the storm, thunderstruck can hit your big generator. There is a chance for each part connected to break as a result.
[*]Prices - Regular prices in the shop.
[/list]

[b]Winter[/b]
[list]
[*]Permafrost - Earth is frozen. You need to use the ripper (Bulldozer's back) to cultivate the earth before digging. If you would not use the ripper, you won't be able to dig.
[*]Freeze - Vehicles are breaking way faster. When the temperature is very low, hoses can break if the connected equipment is turned off, but the water pump is still running. Workers can get sick and be inactive for a while.
[*]Fuel - Higher fuel usage.
[*]Prices - Lower prices in the shop.
[/list]

[b]Summary[/b]
When you try to end the gold mining season but left something outside the hangar, you will receive a prompt about not securing every breakable equipment.
A summary with all your stats will be displayed, after finishing the gold mining season at the Hotel (in the middle of Winter).
You won't be able to finish the season before the winter comes.
After ending the season there you will receive an additional small trophy (jar) with the amount of gold you've collected during the last gold mining season.

[h1]Achievements list[/h1]
https://steamcommunity.com/stats/451340/achievements

[h1]Now let's get digging![/h1]



PS. Known issue on Open Beta Branch:
*Fueling doesn`t work, the issue will be fixed as soon as possible

notes.title: Hard Mode - balance tweaks
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
We're introducing yet another Hard Mode balance changes, based on your suggestions.

[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*]Amount of gold on Hog Pan areas: 1.55x -> 1.25x
[*]Excavator's teeth durability: +150% of previous value
[*]Amount of gold on Claims:  0.42x -> 0.36x
[*]Fuel consumption: 1.25x -> 1.18x
[/list]

How to understand the values:
e.g. "1.55x" is the multiplier of Normal Mode's value

[b]Discussion[/b]
As it turned out to be a widely discussed topic, we have opened a dedicated Discord channel, in which everyone can share their feedback and suggestions regarding the Hard Mode (and other topics in the future).
➡ https://discord.gg/S9wJmsD
We are also participants in this conversation, with the aim to work out a perfect balance with you. Or should we say a "golden mean"? ;)

Now download the update and let's get digging!

notes.title: Update 1.4.2.8711 - Tutorial and Hard Mode are LIVE!
notes.content:

[b]Hello Players,[/b]
With Update 1.4.2, we introduce free content for both rookie miners and experienced prospectors:
[list]
[*]Tutorial
[*]Hard Mode
[/list]

[h1]Tutorial[/h1]
We all have been greenhorns once. Gold mining is no easy business. It comes with a hard work and sacrifices. Thankfully, there's a tutorial. No matter, if you're new to Gold Rush or simulator games in general, you'll be able to start your gold mining operation in no time! And when you get experienced enough, you should start getting excited about...

[h1]Hard Mode[/h1]
It's time to push your skills to the limits! You start with nothing, but a dream of becoming a successful prospector. With enough dedication, nothing will stand in your way of making your American dream come true.
WARNING: Only for the toughest miners in the industry!

[b]Hard Mode features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Disabled 1$ Mode.
[*]Disabled Gold Nugget findings.
[*]Disabled Digging Helper.
[*]Disabled Tutorial Prompts.
[*]Breakdowns can't be disabled.
[*]Breakdowns occur more frequently.
[*]New Game starts with 0$.
[*]Less gold on claims.
[*]Higher prices.
[*]Lowered maximum loan.
[*]Fuel runs out faster.
[*]Disabled workers (for now).
[/list]

[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[b]New features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added Tier 1 tutorial notifications.
[*]Added sunbeams (/god rays) highlighting necessary Tier 1 items.
[*]Made certain DigTube videos obligatory to watch, when using an item or a machine for the first time.
[*]Added possibility to turn off Tutorial in settings.
[*]Added Hard Mode.
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Pickup tires no longer break after restoring the vehicle.
[*]Added missing DigTube notifications.
[/list]

[b]Other:[/b]
[list]
[*]Localized tools names.
[*]Tools names are now displayed in the toolbar.
[*]Added sounds of breaking parts.
[*]Added sounds of fixing.
[*]Added crowbar animation.
[*]Big Excavator optimization.
[*]Updated several translations.
[*]Increased durability of teeth and hydraulic hoses.
[/list]

[h1]Now let's get digging![/h1]

notes.title: Update 1.3.8200 is LIVE!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Prospectors,[/b]

We proudly present the 1.3 Update, which includes:
[list]
[*] New equipment.
[*] New features.
[*] New lacquers.
[*] Performance upgrade.
[*] Bug fixes.
[/list]

[h1]CHANGELOG[/h1]

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] NEW: Big Water Pump.
[*] NEW: Electric Water Pump.
[*] NEW: Big Electric Water Pump.
[*] NEW: Gold Nuggetator – clean miner’s mosses faster. One bucket contains 12 big mosses and 8 smaller ones.
[*] NEW: Online Equipment Store - use laptop to order equipment directly to your claim.
[*] NEW: Online Machines Store - purchase machines via laptop and use Transport services to get them on your claim.
[*] NEW:  Notifications tab on the laptop.
[*] NEW:  Custom vehicle lacquers - change your vehicles' look in the Machine Park.
[*] NEW: Rotating objects while holding them.
[*] NEW: Claim reset - restore your digging ground  
[*] NEW: Excavator's mouse digging mode.
[*] NEW: Season 1 trophy in the tent.
[*] NEW: Huge Hoses.
[*] Improved driving model.
[*] Differentiated Shaker’s, D-Rocker’s, and Glacier Creek’s processing speed.
[*] Lowered the processing speed of T2 & T3 Shakers.
[*] Lowered gold quantity on parcels (new or reset parcels only).
[*] Added possibility to change tips when the game is loading by pressing left or right arrow.
[*] Changed gold balance for new or reset claims.
[*] Added the possibility to mount grates on ST Sluicebox, to gain even more gold from T3+.
		○ Mount up to 4 of grates. Mount a bucket on the side.
		○ Use your small shovel (new tool – press “”4″”) to empty them when they are full.
		○ Don’t forget to turn off the water stream before lifting the grates.
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Gamepad UI support fixes.
[*] Front-End Loader fixes.
[*] Fixed some game-crashing bugs.
[*] UI fixes.
[*] Refined textures.
[*] Reverse light fix - shouldn’t blink on reverse gear anymore.
[*] Frankenstein's door bug fix.
[*] Wave Table fixes – easier to connect hoses.
[*] Bank UI fixes.
[*] Updated models in shops.
[*] Connectors fixes.
[*] Front-End Loader reset fix.
[*] Magnetite separator fixes – pouring water doesn’t fill it anymore.
[*] Fixed bug, which caused time-flow irregularities.
[*] Fixed the bug, when the buckets on truck’s bed were spawning with the shovels in it.
[*] Frankenstein Xbox gamepad fixes – it’s now possible to turn on the belt with the [Y] key instead of the right analog stick.
[/list]

[b]Other:[/b]
[list]
[*] Optimization tweaks.
[*] Front-end Loader optimizations.
[*] Shadows optimization.
[*] UI rework.
[*] Wavetable and Magnetite Separator show how much dirt is in them.
[*] Frankenstein's belt now works with only one button (turn off and on with the same button).
[/list]

[b] Now let's get digging! [/b]

Other:
- Wavetable and Magnetite Separator show how much dirt is in them.
- Frankenstein belt now works with only one button(turn off and on on same button)
- We've optimized the Shadows

notes.title: Update 1.2.7293
notes.content:
Bug fixes:
- Game shouldn't crash when changing machines with [ or ]
- Fixed issue where sounds from machines would still be heard from the delivery location.
- Fixed the sound where Big Franks conveyor belt sound would still be heard after being turned off.
- Fixed an issue where players would get stuck in the pickup truck bed.
- Fixed an issue where cables would get stuck and cause the screen to turn red then blue and crash the game.
- Fixed the moving bucket issue – attaching/detaching hoses to buckets as well as picking up the hose.
- Fixed an issue where the indicators over the mobile wash plant would not be visible. 
- Fixed the issue where the top mat in the sluice would get stuck on the Nighthawk Claim.
- Fixed the issue where players would get stuck between the ladders and the sluices.
- Fixed the issue where players would exit the dump truck and start to fly upwards.
- Fixed the issue where some players are crashing when switching vehicles with the hotkeys.
- Fixed a sound issue where the portable generator sound would remain if moved from one location to another.
- Fixed an issue where players would get stuck in small holes at the panning area
- Gold should no longer fall through the glass when panning.
- Fixed Magnetite separator issue where it would not display indicators on none flat surfaces.
- Fixed an issue where indicators would not be visible after loading a save game.
- A bug on teleport when getting off machines that could lead to soft lock of game
- Tent collision fixes
- Fixed an issue where the player would get stuck near slucie boxes 
- Fixed de-sync of end day time
- Dozer fix (should be easier to make ramps)
- Fixed pressing esc on graphics settings
- Fixing issue for showing total gold on gold map

Other:
- Pressing M/TAB/J when in Map/Journal will now close them as well 
- Adjustment to bedrock on Pine Valley and Nighthawk (there was a glitch that you could see digging ground but you could not dig it)
- Beep sound removed on some machines
- Front end loader power adjustment
- Back light added to some machines
- You can move stuff with frontend loader and cables
- Bucket on the digger is more flexible
- Added lights in big generator
- Nighthawks claim entrance has been made slightly wider.
- Streaming assets added to game options 
- Improved the spawn locations of items bought at the store

notes.title: Update 1.1.5836
notes.content:
Features:

- Added Quicksave (F5), QuickLoad (F9) and Hide HUD (F10) to the keybindings.
- Added area to sell equipment and machines
- Added Autosave option to the main menu.
- Added Quick Swap between machines on the same claim ( '[' and ']' ).
- Added Power Splitter to the Equipment Store.
- Added Water Hoses Connectors to the Equipment Store
- Added Water Splitter to the Equipment Store.
- Added Autosave System
- Added Cloud Saves on Steam

Bug Fixes:

- Fixed the bug with repaying loan installment after every loading of the game.
- Fixed broken Separators, Wash Plants, and Bucket that didn't collect any gold.
- There should be no problems with cable after transporting Big Generator or Wash Plant.
- Dump Truck shouldn't explode anymore when raming the Wash Plant.
- Fixed bug, when you had infinite dirt while digging at the bottom of the claim.
- Fixed bug when bed has got into cabin geometry - Slightly reduced the turning possibility on Dumptruck.
- Fixed bug with loader having less gold than excavator
- Fixed bug, where there was no sounds in vehicles, generators or pumps after loading the game.

Balance Changes:

- Duration of the day has been significantly lenghtened. It's 120 minutes now per in-game day.
- Significantly increased fueling speed.
- Added possibility to repay the loan faster
- Reworked fuel consumption - Now machines should use it a lot faster because it's correlated with in-game time instead of real-life time
- Reworked workers - Now they are correlated with in-game time instead of real-life time and should take money and give gold properly

Other:

- Navigating through menu on controller has been improved.
- Dump Truck and Walking got new default keybindings on controller. It may force you to set your custom keybindings once again.
- Added 5th Camera to the Excavator's "Show Control" window.
- Minimum RAM requirement in the in-game system check is now 12 GB.
- Added bunch of new tips to the loading screen.
- Machines and Environment sounds have been separated.
- Added a lot of fueling related sounds.
- Renting of the claim has been reworked and now works properly.
- Added sounds to Wave Table
- Added sounds to attaching the trailer
- Removed Shadows from Particles
- Limited framerate in menu to 120 FPS.
- Journal description has been updated to match changes in game
- Tools are now also available by pressing 1,2,3 keys

notes.title: Update 1.1.5642
notes.content:
Features:
- Dump Truck has been added to the game
- Conveyor Belt has been added to the game as an attachment to the Shaker
- Conveyor Belt's Container has been added to the game as an attachment to the Shaker

Bug fixes:
- Prompt window about minimal hardware requirements can now be closed permanently
- Run or walk can be chosen now as default moving action, check controls options
- In Bank in selling panel list of gold bars, list is now refreshed correctly and show price for each bar
- While melting gold bar at blacksmith, balance account cannot go under 0$
- Machines in Machine Shop cannot be fueled before buy
- Fuel hoses should not brake any more
- Memory leak when holding ground on shovel (skinned meshes problem)

- Signs on the claims to help players localize important places
- In the city center you can find posters with faces of our kickstarter bakers and their short messages
- Saves are now encrypted and compressed
- Dutch language added
- Added Badges, Trading Cards, Emoticons, Profile Backgrounds
- DigTube updated with new content

Known issues:
- Shadows below particles in vehicles are squared

notes.title: Update 1.0.5428
notes.content:
Bug fixes:
- Hitting cancel when deleting save works properly now

- Warning prompt in main menu when hardware does not meet minimal requirements

- Money cheat is blocked

-Sometimes mobile washplant can detach from pickup and won`t attach again. To attach it you need save game then load it

notes.title: Changelog (rev. 5012)
notes.content:
New Languages - We've added new languages to the game
Digtube - We've added another source of knowledge in our game. Watch some new clips about how to play our game
Tutorial brochures in journal - We've added simple schemes on how to start the game and what to do in it
flickering - We've removed flickering from the game
Washplant save/load bug - Now, you shouldn't have problem with seting up wash plant after loading the game
Save state Rent/Buy bug - Save state should now tell you exactly how many claims are rented/bought
Unplugging the cables from big stationary generator - Loading shouldn't break your big stationary generator
Tutorial Prompt - We've added a quick reminder on game start in upper left prompt
Tablet modular upgrades - We've changed the tablet system, so now you have to unlock new modules instead of having all of them
New Workers after buying module - Now Workers are sending their CVs after you buy a hiring module
Washplant - grille mosses system - When you don't put your grille on the mosses, the gold is washed out and starts to diminish
Mosses cleaning - animation - Bucket should act normal now, instead of being kind of posessed
Loan Taken info - We made Parcel Renting and Loan Taking more similar in feedback
Renting parcel owner - Now when you rent a claim, you don't become an owner suddenly
Cables Extensions - We've added Extensions of the power cable, so you can make them longer and longer
save scroll - You can scroll the saves properly now
black splash screen intro - We've added black splash screen intro
parcels visuals in bank - We've corrected visuals bug in parcels tab
checkout in part shop reset after load - Now checkout should reset after loading the game
collision on shelves in pine valley - Shelves in pine valley got their colissions now
added 4m ropes - We've added shorter ropes
differential lock in loader prompt - Now there should be the prompt about differential lock in loader, when you should turn it on

notes.title: Changelog (Rev. 4795)
notes.content:
Washplant Mats bug - Mats should work properly now.
Stationary Fuel tank - You will be able to transport and refill a fuel tank now. 
Vehicles - There were series of changes in friction, hydraulic systems, power, steering etc. Now it should feel better.
Sound - Added a lot of sounds to the game
Promopts - Added missing prompts to the machineshop, transport and bank
New Magnetite Price - Now, collecting magnetite and selling it in factory will be much more profitable
Save System - Fixed bugs with saving
Wash Plant - We've changed the wash plant setting up system. 
Toolbox - We've limited a toolbox, because of no repair system currently in-game. There is some gamebreaking bug, that we need to take care of. Until it wouldn't be fixed, repairs will remain turned off.
Barrier on claims - We've added barriers on claims so you wouldn't be able to get inside before buying one
Driving through water - We've added particles when you drive through the water
Wave Table bugs - We've fixed few wave table problems.
Day counter - There will be no Day 0 all the time anymore
Wash Plant scaffolding - You should find easier where to set up washplant now.
Fuel - Gold relation - Cost of the fuel now depends on gold.
Localization fixes - Few correction in localization

notes.content:
New Balance - We've added new balance to the game prices, fuel consumptions, etc.
Wave table - Wave table is now working properly. It should gather gold for you
FOV - We've added Field of View Option to the Graphics menu
Fuel amount in Jerrycan - We've added visual pointer to jerrycan, now telling us how much fuel is left
Fly me to the moon - Now, items on the ground shouldn't make pickup shoot itself to the sky.
Weather - We've slightly changed weather system, so now there should be more sunny weather than others
Magnetite Trailer - We've added magnetite trailer to the shop. Now, you can gather magnetite from separator and sell it in the factory.
Mobile Wash plant + Pickup bug - Now spawning mobile wash plant should not block pickup driving capabilities.
Gold exchange - We've added chart of the gold value history to the bank 
Caravan - we've added working caravan to the claims (nearby the tent), so you could sleep till morning and avoid working at night.
Longer Days - we've made days twice as long.
More Gold - There is now far more gold than before. You should see your progress of digging gold now.
Memory leak - Partially fixed. We've gotten rid of most of the memory leak. There is still some tweaks to do, but it should be much better now.
New Panning System - Right now, the gold amount and size in the gold pan is dependent on the weight of the gold you should acquire.
Gold Material - Now, gold should be golden again.
General Bug Fixes - We've fixed a lot of minor bugs that don't need to be showed.

notes.title: Changelog (rev. 4535)
notes.content:
Part Shop - added new hints
Hog Pan mats - fixed bug, where you had to detach sluicebox to enable gold gathering on mats.
Wash Plant outline - Outline on wash plant system should be more visible.
Journal localization- We fully localized Journal to english
Azerty Keyboard- Added possibibility to keybind "Show Control" to let Azerty keyboard play the game "normally"
Totem Village - Fixed bug where you go through the map when getting close to the village building
Freeze streaming + circle - Added new way of dealing with world streaming
2 Monitory - Added support to multiscreen. Fixed GUI scaling
Map scaling - Fixed bug, where map showed wrong position on resolutions different than Full HD
Longer cables - We extended all kinds of cables
Longer hook ropes - We extended short hook ropes by one meter
Widoki - streaming - We improved level streaming, so you should see less terrain popups
Gold on the claim - We gave 4 times more gold to the claims
